                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# 项目节点配置指南\\n\\n本文档详细说明了项目中需要配置AI角色的所有节点及其配置方法。\\n\\n## 一、需要配置的节点分类\\n\\n### 1. 独立页面节点（5个）\\n\\n这些节点在独立页面模式下使用，需要创建source为\\\"independent-page\\\"的AI角色。\\n\\n| 节点类型 | 节点名称 | 路径 | 匹配规则 |\\n|---------|---------|------|---------|\\n| &amp;#96;ai-search&amp;#96; | AI问答 | &amp;#96;/node/ai-search&amp;#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\\\"ai-search\\\"、\\\"ai问答\\\"、\\\"智能搜索\\\"等 |\\n| &amp;#96;tech-package&amp;#96; | 技术包装 | &amp;#96;/node/tech-package&amp;#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\\\"tech-package\\\"、\\\"技术包装\\\"等 |\\n| &amp;#96;promotion-strategy&amp;#96; | 技术策略 | &amp;#96;/node/promotion-strategy&amp;#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\\\"promotion-strategy\\\"、\\\"tech-strategy\\\"、\\\"技术策略\\\"等 |\\n| &amp;#96;core-draft&amp;#96; | 技术通稿 | &amp;#96;/node/core-draft&amp;#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\\\"core-draft\\\"、\\\"tech-article\\\"、\\\"技术通稿\\\"等 |\\n| &amp;#96;speech&amp;#96; | 发布会演讲稿 | &amp;#96;/node/speech&amp;#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\\\"speech\\\"、\\\"发布会\\\"、\\\"演讲稿\\\"等 |\\n\\n**配置方法**：\\n1. 在AI角色管理页面创建新角色\\n2. 设置source为\\\"independent-page\\\"\\n3. 角色ID、名称或描述需要匹配上述规则\\n4. 系统会自动匹配并应用\\n\\n### 2. 工作流Agent节点\\n\\n在工作流编辑器中创建的Agent节点，需要为每个节点配置agentId。\\n\\n**配置方法**：\\n1. 进入工作流编辑器（&amp;#96;/agent-workflow&amp;#96;）\\n2. 创建或编辑工作流\\n3. 添加Agent节点\\n4. 在节点配置中选择对应的AI角色（agentId）\\n5. 注意：工作流中的Agent节点只支持Dify类型的角色，不支持Direct Agent类型\\n\\n**相关代码位置**：\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;#96; - &amp;#96;executeAgentNode()&amp;#96;方法\\n- &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/AgentNode.tsx&amp;#96; - Agent节点组件\\n\\n### 3. 字段映射功能对象（8个）\\n\\n在字段映射配置中，可以为每个功能对象配置专属的agentId或workflowId。\\n\\n| 功能类型 | 功能名称 | 配置位置 |\\n|---------|---------|---------|\\n| &amp;#96;five-view-analysis&amp;#96; | 技术转译（五看） | 字段映射管理页面 |\","

                  "lineNumber": 6679,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"| &amp;#96;tech-strategy&amp;#96; | 技术策略 | &amp;#96;/tech-strategy&amp;#96; | techStrategyConfig | ✅ 有效 |\\n| &amp;#96;tech-article&amp;#96; | 技术通稿 | &amp;#96;/tech-article&amp;#96; | techArticleConfig | ✅ 有效 |\\n| &amp;#96;press-release&amp;#96; | 发布会稿 | &amp;#96;/press-release&amp;#96; | pressReleaseConfig | ✅ 有效 |\\n| &amp;#96;ai-qa&amp;#96; | AI问答 | &amp;#96;/ai-qa&amp;#96; | aiQaConfig | ✅ 有效 |\\n\\n**配置要求：**\\n- 需要配置工作流（通过字段映射配置）\\n- 需要配置功能Agent（五看、三定等）\\n- 每个页面可以配置不同的工具集（enabledToolIds）\\n\\n**页面配置位置：** &amp;#96;frontend/src/configs/pageConfigs.ts&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3. 工作流编辑器节点（8个）\\n\\n这些节点用于工作流编辑器，支持可视化编排：\\n\\n| 节点类型 | 节点名称 | 分类 | 配置要求 | 状态 |\\n|---------|---------|------|---------|------|\\n| &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96; | Agent节点 | agent | 需要配置agentId（AI角色ID） | ✅ 有效 |\\n| &amp;#96;input&amp;#96; | 输入节点 | io | 定义工作流输入参数 | ✅ 有效 |\\n| &amp;#96;output&amp;#96; | 输出节点 | io | 定义工作流输出参数 | ✅ 有效 |\\n| &amp;#96;condition&amp;#96; | 条件判断 | logic | 配置条件表达式 | ✅ 有效 |\\n| &amp;#96;assign&amp;#96; | 变量赋值 | data | 配置变量名和值 | ✅ 有效 |\\n| &amp;#96;merge&amp;#96; | 数据合并 | data | 配置合并策略 | ✅ 有效 |\\n| &amp;#96;transform&amp;#96; | 数据转换 | data | 配置转换规则 | ✅ 有效 |\\n| &amp;#96;memory&amp;#96; | 文本记忆 | data | 配置文本存储 | ✅ 有效 |\\n\\n**配置要求：**\\n- Agent节点：必须配置agentId，关联AI角色（source: 'agent-workflow'）\\n- 其他节点：根据节点类型配置相应的参数\\n\\n**节点类型定义位置：** &amp;#96;frontend/src/config/workflowNodeTypes.ts&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 4. 功能Agent节点（8个）\\n\\n这些是子Agent，通过字段映射配置关联到工作流或AI角色：\\n\\n| 功能类型 | 功能名称 | 使用页面 | 配置方式 | 状态 |\\n|---------|---------|---------|---------|------|\\n| &amp;#96;five-view-analysis&amp;#96; | 五看/技术转译 | tech-package, tech-strategy, press-release | 字段映射配置 | ✅ 有效 |\\n| &amp;#96;three-fix-analysis&amp;#96; | 三定/用户场景挖掘 | tech-package, tech-strategy, press-release | 字段映射配置 | ✅ 有效 |\\n| &amp;#96;tech-matrix&amp;#96; | 技术矩阵 | tech-package, tech-strategy, press-release | 字段映射配置 | ✅ 有效 |\","
                },

                  "lineNumber": 7710,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"// AI角色使用情况分析工具\\n// 用于分析AI角色在哪些功能页面中被使用\\n\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from '../types/aiRole';\\nimport { INDEPENDENT_NODE_CONFIGS } from './nodeRoleMapping';\\n\\n/**\\n * AI角色使用位置\\n */\\nexport interface AIRoleUsageLocation {\\n  type: 'independent-page' | 'agent-workflow' | 'multi-chat' | 'workflow-editor';\\n  name: string;  // 位置名称（如 \\\"AI问答\\\"、\\\"智能工作流\\\"）\\n  path?: string;  // 页面路径（如 \\\"/node/ai-search\\\"）\\n  description?: string;  // 描述信息\\n  nodeId?: string;  // 节点ID（如果是工作流节点）\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * AI角色使用情况\\n */\\nexport interface AIRoleUsage {\\n  roleId: string;\\n  roleName: string;\\n  locations: AIRoleUsageLocation[];\\n  totalUsageCount: number;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 分析AI角色在独立页面中的使用情况\\n */\\nfunction analyzeIndependentPageUsage(\\n  role: AIRoleConfig,\\n  allRoles: AIRoleConfig[]\\n): AIRoleUsageLocation[] {\\n  const locations: AIRoleUsageLocation[] = [];\\n\\n  // 检查每个独立页面节点配置\\n  for (const nodeConfig of INDEPENDENT_NODE_CONFIGS) {\\n    // 检查角色是否匹配该节点\\n    const matches = nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&amp;gt; \\n      pattern.test(role.id) || \\n      pattern.test(role.name) || \\n      pattern.test(role.description || '')\\n    );\\n\\n    if (matches &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (role.source === 'independent-page' || !role.source)) {\\n      // 确定页面路径\\n      let pagePath = '';\\n      switch (nodeConfig.nodeType) {\\n        case 'ai-search':\\n          pagePath = '/node/ai-search';\\n          break;\\n        case 'tech-package':\\n          pagePath = '/node/tech-package';\\n          break;\\n        case 'promotion-strategy':\\n          pagePath = '/node/promotion-strategy';\\n          break;\\n        case 'core-draft':\\n          pagePath = '/node/core-draft';\\n          break;\\n        case 'speech':\\n          pagePath = '/node/speech';\\n          break;\\n      }\\n\\n      locations.push({\\n        type: 'independent-page',\\n        name: nodeConfig.name,\\n        path: pagePath,\\n        description: nodeConfig.description,\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  return locations;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 分析AI角色在Agent工作流中的使用情况\\n * 需要检查所有工作流中是否使用了该角色\\n */\\nasync function analyzeAgentWorkflowUsage(\\n  role: AIRoleConfig,\\n  allRoles: AIRoleConfig[]\\n): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleUsageLocation[]&amp;gt; {\\n  const locations: AIRoleUsageLocation[] = [];\\n\\n  try {\\n    // 动态导入以避免循环依赖\\n    const { agentWorkflowService } = await import('../services/agentWorkflowService');\\n    const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n\\n    for (const workflow of workflows) {\\n      // 检查工作流的节点中是否使用了该角色\\n      const nodesUsingRole = workflow.nodes.filter(\\n        node =&amp;gt; node.agentId === role.id\\n      );\\n\\n      if (nodesUsingRole.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        locations.push({\\n          type: 'agent-workflow',\\n          name: workflow.name || '未命名工作流',\\n          path: &amp;#96;/agent-workflow&amp;#96;,\\n          description: &amp;#96;${nodesUsingRole.length}个节点使用此角色&amp;#96;,\\n          nodeId: nodesUsingRole.map(n =&amp;gt; n.id).join(', '),\\n        });\\n      }\\n    }\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.warn('分析Agent工作流使用情况失败:', error);\\n  }\\n\\n  return locations;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 分析AI角色在所有功能中的使用情况\\n */\\nexport async function analyzeAIRoleUsage(\\n  role: AIRoleConfig,\\n  allRoles: AIRoleConfig[] = []\\n): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleUsage&amp;gt; {\\n  const locations: AIRoleUsageLocation[] = [];\\n\\n  // 1. 分析独立页面使用情况\\n  const independentPageLocations = analyzeIndependentPageUsage(role, allRoles);\\n  locations.push(...independentPageLocations);\\n\\n  // 2. 分析Agent工作流使用情况\\n  const agentWorkflowLocations = await analyzeAgentWorkflowUsage(role, allRoles);\\n  locations.push(...agentWorkflowLocations);\\n\\n  // 3. 检查是否在智能工作流模板中使用（通过source判断）\\n  if (role.source === 'smart-workflow') {\\n    const alreadyInWorkflow = locations.some(\\n      loc =&amp;gt; loc.type === 'agent-workflow'\\n    );\\n    if (!alreadyInWorkflow) {\\n      locations.push({\\n        type: 'agent-workflow',\\n        name: '智能工作流',\\n        path: '/agent-workflow',\\n        description: '标记为智能工作流角色，可能在工作流中使用',\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  // 4. 检查是否可以在多窗口对话中使用（所有启用的角色都可以）\\n  if (role.enabled) {\\n    locations.push({\\n      type: 'multi-chat',\\n      name: '多窗口对话',\\n      path: '/multi-chat',\\n      description: '可以在多窗口对话功能中使用',\\n    });\\n  }\\n\\n  return {\\n    roleId: role.id,\\n    roleName: role.name,\\n    locations,\\n    totalUsageCount: locations.length,\\n  };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 批量分析多个AI角色的使用情况\\n */\\nexport async function analyzeMultipleAIRoleUsage(\\n  roles: AIRoleConfig[]\\n): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleUsage[]&amp;gt; {\\n  const results: AIRoleUsage[] = [];\\n\\n  for (const role of roles) {\\n    try {\\n      const usage = await analyzeAIRoleUsage(role, roles);\\n      results.push(usage);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(&amp;#96;分析角色 ${role.name} 使用情况失败:&amp;#96;, error);\\n      // 即使分析失败，也添加一个空结果\\n      results.push({\\n        roleId: role.id,\\n        roleName: role.name,\\n        locations: [],\\n        totalUsageCount: 0,\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  return results;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取使用情况描述文本\\n */\\nexport function getUsageDescription(usage: AIRoleUsage): string {\\n  if (usage.totalUsageCount === 0) {\\n    return '未在任何功能中使用';\\n  }\\n\\n  const locationNames = usage.locations.map(loc =&amp;gt; loc.name).join('、');\\n  return &amp;#96;在 ${usage.totalUsageCount} 个位置使用：${locationNames}&amp;#96;;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取使用情况简短的标签文本（用于UI显示）\\n */\\nexport function getUsageBadges(usage: AIRoleUsage): string[] {\\n  const badges: string[] = [];\\n  const types = new Set(usage.locations.map(loc =&amp;gt; loc.type));\\n\\n  if (types.has('independent-page')) {\\n    badges.push('独立页面');\\n  }\\n  if (types.has('agent-workflow')) {\\n    badges.push('工作流');\\n  }\\n  if (types.has('multi-chat')) {\\n    badges.push('多窗口对话');\\n  }\\n\\n  return badges;\\n}\\n\\n\\n\","
                },

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\\nimport { \\n  Info, \\n  ChevronDown, \\n  ChevronUp, \\n  CheckCircle2, \\n  AlertCircle, \\n  Workflow,\\n  FileText,\\n  Target,\\n  Search,\\n  Package,\\n  Mic,\\n  Settings,\\n  ExternalLink\\n} from 'lucide-react';\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from '../types/aiRole';\\nimport { getAllNodeTypeConfigs } from '../utils/nodeRoleMapping';\\nimport aiRoleService from '../services/aiRoleService';\\nimport { aiSearchService } from '../services/aiSearchService';\\nimport { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\\n\\ninterface NodeConfigStatus {\\n  nodeType: string;\\n  nodeName: string;\\n  icon: React.ReactNode;\\n  configured: boolean;\\n  roleId?: string;\\n  roleName?: string;\\n  source: 'independent-page' | 'workflow' | 'field-mapping';\\n  path?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface AIRoleConfigInfoBoxProps {\\n  roles: AIRoleConfig[];\\n  onRefresh?: () =&amp;gt; void;\\n  hideHeader?: boolean; // 是否隐藏标题栏\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * AI角色配置信息框\\n * 显示需要配置AI角色的节点及其配置状态\\n */\\nconst AIRoleConfigInfoBox: React.FC&amp;lt;AIRoleConfigInfoBoxProps&amp;gt; = ({ roles, onRefresh, hideHeader = false }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);\\n  const [nodeStatuses, setNodeStatuses] = useState&amp;lt;NodeConfigStatus[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; 0 &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"mt-4 p-3 bg-blue-100 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-start gap-2\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;AlertCircle className=\\\"w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"text-sm font-medium text-blue-900\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                    配置提示\\n                  &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"text-xs text-blue-700 mt-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                    &amp;lt;ul className=\\\"list-disc list-inside space-y-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;li&amp;gt;独立页面节点：创建source为\\\"独立页面\\\"的AI角色，系统会自动匹配&amp;lt;/li&amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;li&amp;gt;工作流Agent节点：在工作流编辑器中为Agent节点选择AI角色&amp;lt;/li&amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;li&amp;gt;字段映射功能对象：在字段映射管理页面为功能对象配置agentId&amp;lt;/li&amp;gt;\\n                    &amp;lt;/ul&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      )}\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default AIRoleConfigInfoBox;\\n\","

                  "lineNumber": 10417,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const AIRoleConfigInfoBox: React.FC&amp;lt;AIRoleConfigInfoBoxProps&amp;gt; = \\nconst loadNodeStatuses = async \\nconfig =&amp;gt; {\\n\\n            path = '#';\\n        }\\n\\n        statuses.push({\\n          nodeType: config.nodeType,\\n          nodeName: config.name,\\n          icon,\\n          configured: !!matchedRole,\\n          roleId: matchedRole?.id,\\n          roleName: matchedRole?.name,\\n          source: 'independent-page',\\n          path\\n        });\\n      });\\n\\n      // 2. 工作流Agent节点（需要检查工作流中的agent节点）\\n      // 这里可以通过API获取工作流信息，暂时显示提示\\n      statuses.push({\\n        nodeType: 'workflow-agent',\\n        nodeName: '工作流Agent节点',\\n        icon: &amp;lt;Workflow className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;,\\n        configured: false, // 需要从工作流API获取实际状态\\n        source: 'workflow',\\n        path: '/agent-workflow'\\n      });\\n\\n      // 3. 字段映射功能对象（需要检查字段映射配置）\\n      const featureTypes = [\\n        { type: 'five-view-analysis', name: '技术转译（五看）', label: '五看分析' },\\n        { type: 'three-fix-analysis', name: '用户场景挖掘（三定）', label: '三定分析' },\\n        { type: 'tech-matrix', name: '技术矩阵', label: '技术矩阵' },\\n        { type: 'propagation-strategy', name: '传播策略', label: '传播策略' },\\n        { type: 'exhibition-video', name: '展具与视频', label: '展具与视频' },\\n        { type: 'translation', name: '翻译', label: '翻译' },\\n        { type: 'ppt-outline', name: '技术讲稿', label: '技术讲稿' },\\n        { type: 'script', name: '脚本', label: '脚本' },\\n      ];\\n\\n      // 从字段映射配置中获取agentId配置状态\\n;\\n;\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 12085,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const AIRoleConfigInfoBox: React.FC&amp;lt;AIRoleConfigInfoBoxProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n          {/* 工作流Agent节点 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;h4 className=\\\"text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2 flex items-center gap-2\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;Workflow className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n              工作流Agent节点\\n            &amp;lt;/h4&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"space-y-2\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {nodeStatuses\\n                .filter(s =&amp;gt; s.source === 'workflow')\\n                .map((status, index) =&amp;gt; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div\\n                    key={index}\\n                    className=\\\"flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-lg border bg-yellow-50 border-yellow-200\\\"\\n                  &amp;gt;\\n                    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-3 flex-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"p-1.5 rounded bg-yellow-100\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                        {status.icon}\\n                      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"font-medium text-sm text-gray-900\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                          {status.nodeName}\\n                        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"text-xs text-gray-600 mt-0.5\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                          在工作流编辑器中为Agent节点配置AI角色\\n                        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                    &amp;lt;button\\n                      onClick={(e) =&amp;gt; {\\n                        e.stopPropagation();\\n                        handleGoToNode(status.path || '/agent-workflow');\\n                      }}\\n                      className=\\\"px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center gap-1\\\"\\n                    &amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;ExternalLink className=\\\"w-3 h-3\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                      前往配置\\n                    &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                ))}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 字段映射功能对象 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;h4 className=\\n;\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 13263,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# 项目节点配置指南\\n\\n本文档详细说明了项目中需要配置AI角色的所有节点及其配置方法。\\n\\n## 一、需要配置的节点分类\\n\\n### 1. 独立页面节点（5个）\\n\\n这些节点在独立页面模式下使用，需要创建source为\\\"independent-page\\\"的AI角色。\\n\\n| 节点类型 | 节点名称 | 路径 | 匹配规则 |\\n|---------|---------|------|---------|\\n| &amp;#96;ai-search&amp;#96; | AI问答 | &amp;#96;/node/ai-search&amp;#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\\\"ai-search\\\"、\\\"ai问答\\\"、\\\"智能搜索\\\"等 |\\n| &amp;#96;tech-package&amp;#96; | 技术包装 | &amp;#96;/node/tech-package&amp;#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\\\"tech-package\\\"、\\\"技术包装\\\"等 |\\n| &amp;#96;promotion-strategy&amp;#96; | 技术策略 | &amp;#96;/node/promotion-strategy&amp;#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\\\"promotion-strategy\\\"、\\\"tech-strategy\\\"、\\\"技术策略\\\"等 |\\n| &amp;#96;core-draft&amp;#96; | 技术通稿 | &amp;#96;/node/core-draft&amp;#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\\\"core-draft\\\"、\\\"tech-article\\\"、\\\"技术通稿\\\"等 |\\n| &amp;#96;speech&amp;#96; | 发布会演讲稿 | &amp;#96;/node/speech&amp;#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\\\"speech\\\"、\\\"发布会\\\"、\\\"演讲稿\\\"等 |\\n\\n**配置方法**：\\n1. 在AI角色管理页面创建新角色\\n2. 设置source为\\\"independent-page\\\"\\n3. 角色ID、名称或描述需要匹配上述规则\\n4. 系统会自动匹配并应用\\n\\n### 2. 工作流Agent节点\\n\\n在工作流编辑器中创建的Agent节点，需要为每个节点配置agentId。\\n\\n**配置方法**：\\n1. 进入工作流编辑器（&amp;#96;/agent-workflow&amp;#96;）\\n2. 创建或编辑工作流\\n3. 添加Agent节点\\n4. 在节点配置中选择对应的AI角色（agentId）\\n5. 注意：工作流中的Agent节点只支持Dify类型的角色，不支持Direct Agent类型\\n\\n**相关代码位置**：\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;#96; - &amp;#96;executeAgentNode()&amp;#96;方法\\n- &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/AgentNode.tsx&amp;#96; - Agent节点组件\\n\\n### 3. 字段映射功能对象（8个）\\n\\n在字段映射配置中，可以为每个功能对象配置专属的agentId或workflowId。\\n\\n| 功能类型 | 功能名称 | 配置位置 |\\n|---------|---------|---------|\\n| &amp;#96;five-view-analysis&amp;#96; | 技术转译（五看） | 字段映射管理页面 |\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13374,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"1. 进入工作流编辑器（&amp;#96;/agent-workflow&amp;#96;）\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13513,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"3. 配置Direct Agent（如果provider为direct-agent）\\n   ├─ LLM配置（apiKey, apiBaseUrl, model）\\n   ├─ Prompt配置（systemPrompt, variables）\\n   ├─ 上下文策略\\n   └─ 工具配置（可选）\\n\\n4. 节点页面自动匹配AI角色\\n   └─ 通过nodeRoleMapping.ts中的匹配规则\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2. 标准页面配置流程\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n1. 配置工作流（可选）\\n   └─ 在字段映射管理页面配置\\n\\n2. 配置功能Agent\\n   ├─ 在字段映射管理页面配置\\n   ├─ 关联工作流ID或AI角色ID\\n   ├─ 配置输入输出字段映射\\n   └─ 按pageType区分配置\\n\\n3. 页面自动加载配置\\n   ├─ 从字段映射配置加载工作流\\n   ├─ 从字段映射配置加载功能Agent\\n   └─ 根据pageConfig显示可用工具\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3. 工作流节点配置流程\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n1. 创建AI角色（用于Agent节点）\\n   ├─ source: 'agent-workflow'\\n   └─ provider: 'dify'（工作流中只支持Dify类型）\\n\\n2. 创建工作流\\n   ├─ 添加Input节点（定义输入）\\n   ├─ 添加Agent节点（配置agentId）\\n   ├─ 添加其他逻辑节点（condition, assign等）\\n   └─ 添加Output节点（定义输出）\\n\\n3. 执行工作流\\n   └─ 通过AgentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 四、配置检查清单\\n\\n### ✅ 独立页面节点配置检查\\n\\n- [ ] ai-search节点：已创建source='independent-page'的AI角色\\n- [ ] tech-package节点：已创建source='independent-page'的AI角色\\n- [ ] promotion-strategy节点：已创建source='independent-page'的AI角色\\n- [ ] core-draft节点：已创建source='independent-page'的AI角色\\n- [ ] speech节点：已创建source='independent-page'的AI角色（或使用press-release配置）\\n\\n### ✅ 标准页面配置检查\\n\\n- [ ] tech-package页面：已配置工作流和功能Agent\\n- [ ] tech-strategy页面：已配置工作流和功能Agent\\n- [ ] tech-article页面：已配置工作流和功能Agent\\n- [ ] press-release页面：已配置工作流和功能Agent\\n- [ ] ai-qa页面：已配置工作流和功能Agent\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13638,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"   ├─ source: 'agent-workflow'\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14560,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"优先级3: 默认配置\\n  └─ 使用系统默认配置（如果存在）\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2. 标准页面配置优先级\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n优先级1: 字段映射配置中的工作流\\n  └─ 从字段映射配置加载该pageType的工作流\\n\\n优先级2: 用户选择的工作流\\n  └─ 从localStorage加载用户上次选择的工作流\\n\\n优先级3: 默认工作流\\n  └─ 使用系统默认工作流\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3. 功能Agent配置优先级\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n优先级1: 字段映射配置中的agentId\\n  └─ 如果featureObject配置了agentId，直接调用AI角色\\n\\n优先级2: 字段映射配置中的workflowId\\n  └─ 如果featureObject配置了workflowId，调用工作流\\n\\n优先级3: 当前页面的默认工作流\\n  └─ 使用当前页面配置的工作流\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 七、配置建议\\n\\n### 1. 独立页面节点配置建议\\n\\n- 为每个独立页面节点创建专门的AI角色\\n- 使用清晰的命名规则，便于自动匹配\\n- 建议命名格式：&amp;#96;{节点类型}-independent-page&amp;#96;\\n- 例如：&amp;#96;ai-search-independent-page&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;tech-package-independent-page&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2. 标准页面配置建议\\n\\n- 为每个页面类型配置专门的工作流\\n- 功能Agent按页面类型区分配置\\n- 使用字段映射管理页面统一管理\\n- 建议工作流命名格式：&amp;#96;{页面类型}-workflow&amp;#96;\\n- 例如：&amp;#96;tech-package-workflow&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;tech-strategy-workflow&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3. 工作流节点配置建议\\n\\n- Agent节点使用source='agent-workflow'的AI角色\\n- 工作流中只支持Dify类型的AI角色\\n- 合理使用逻辑节点（condition, assign等）构建复杂流程\\n- 使用Output节点明确定义输出结构\\n\\n## 八、总结\\n\\n### 需要配置的节点总数：21个\\n\\n- **独立页面节点**：5个\\n- **标准页面节点**：5个（通过页面配置）\\n- **工作流编辑器节点**：8个\\n- **功能Agent节点**：8个\\n\\n### 所有节点都是有效的\\n\\n项目中定义的所有节点类型都在前端页面中有实际使用，没有废弃的节点。\\n\\n### 配置管理位置\\n\\n1. **AI角色配置**：&amp;#96;/ai-roles&amp;#96; - AI角色管理页面\\n2. **字段映射配置**：&amp;#96;/field-mapping-management&amp;#96; - 字段映射管理页面\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14745,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"- Agent节点使用source='agent-workflow'的AI角色\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 15234,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\\nimport { \\n  Info, \\n  ChevronDown, \\n  ChevronUp, \\n  CheckCircle2, \\n  AlertCircle, \\n  Workflow,\\n  FileText,\\n  Target,\\n  Search,\\n  Package,\\n  Mic,\\n  Settings,\\n  ExternalLink\\n} from 'lucide-react';\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from '../types/aiRole';\\nimport { getAllNodeTypeConfigs } from '../utils/nodeRoleMapping';\\nimport aiRoleService from '../services/aiRoleService';\\nimport { aiSearchService } from '../services/aiSearchService';\\nimport { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\\n\\ninterface NodeConfigStatus {\\n  nodeType: string;\\n  nodeName: string;\\n  icon: React.ReactNode;\\n  configured: boolean;\\n  roleId?: string;\\n  roleName?: string;\\n  source: 'independent-page' | 'workflow' | 'field-mapping';\\n  path?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface AIRoleConfigInfoBoxProps {\\n  roles: AIRoleConfig[];\\n  onRefresh?: () =&amp;gt; void;\\n  hideHeader?: boolean; // 是否隐藏标题栏\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * AI角色配置信息框\\n * 显示需要配置AI角色的节点及其配置状态\\n */\\nconst AIRoleConfigInfoBox: React.FC&amp;lt;AIRoleConfigInfoBoxProps&amp;gt; = ({ roles, onRefresh, hideHeader = false }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);\\n  const [nodeStatuses, setNodeStatuses] = useState&amp;lt;NodeConfigStatus[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadNodeStatuses();\\n  }, [roles]);\\n\\n  const loadNodeStatuses = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setLoading(true);\\n    try {\\n      const statuses: NodeConfigStatus[] = [];\\n\\n      // 1. 独立页面节点（已删除 node/* 功能子页面，不再显示）\\n      // 这些节点对应的页面已删除，因此不再在配置信息框中显示\\n\\n      // 2. 工作流Agent节点（需要检查工作流中的agent节点）\\n      // 这里可以通过API获取工作流信息，暂时显示提示\\n      statuses.push({\\n        nodeType: 'workflow-agent',\\n        nodeName: '工作流Agent节点',\\n        icon: &amp;lt;Workflow className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;,\\n        configured: false, // 需要从工作流API获取实际状态\\n        source: 'workflow',\\n        path: '/agent-workflow'\\n      });\\n\\n      // 3. 字段映射功能对象（需要检查字段映射配置）\\n      const featureTypes = [\\n        { type: 'five-view-analysis', name: '技术转译（五看）', label: '五看分析' },\\n        { type: 'three-fix-analysis', name: '用户场景挖掘（三定）', label: '三定分析' },\\n        { type: 'tech-matrix', name: '技术矩阵', label: '技术矩阵' },\\n        { type: 'propagation-strategy', name: '传播策略', label: '传播策略' },\\n        { type: 'exhibition-video', name: '展具与视频', label: '展具与视频' },\\n        { type: 'translation', name: '翻译', label: '翻译' },\\n        { type: 'ppt-outline', name: '技术讲稿', label: '技术讲稿' },\\n        { type: 'script', name: '脚本', label: '脚本' },\\n      ];\\n\\n      // 从字段映射配置中获取agentId配置状态\\n      try {\\n        const fieldMappingConfigs = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\\n        const allFeatureObjects = fieldMappingConfigs.flatMap(\\n          config =&amp;gt; config.config.featureObjects || []\\n        );\\n\\n        featureTypes.forEach(feature =&amp;gt; {\\n          const featureConfig = allFeatureObjects.find(\\n            (fo: any) =&amp;gt; fo.featureType === feature.type &amp;amp;&amp;amp; fo.agentId\\n          );\\n          const configured = !!featureConfig?.agentId;\\n          const roleId = featureConfig?.agentId;\\n          const matchedRole = roleId ? roles.find(r =&amp;gt; r.id === roleId) : null;\\n\\n          statuses.push({\\n            nodeType: feature.type,\\n            nodeName: feature.name,\\n            icon: &amp;lt;Settings className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;,\\n            configured,\\n            roleId,\\n            roleName: matchedRole?.name,\\n            source: 'field-mapping',\\n            path: '/field-mapping-management'\\n          });\\n        });\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        // 如果获取字段映射配置失败，显示为未配置\\n        console.warn('获取字段映射配置失败:', error);\\n        featureTypes.forEach(feature =&amp;gt; {\\n          statuses.push({\\n            nodeType: feature.type,\\n            nodeName: feature.name,\\n            icon: &amp;lt;Settings className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;,\\n            configured: false,\\n            source: 'field-mapping',\\n            path: '/field-mapping-management'\\n          });\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      setNodeStatuses(statuses);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载节点配置状态失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const configuredCount = nodeStatuses.filter(s =&amp;gt;                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * AI角色配置信息框\\n * 显示需要配置AI角色的节点及其配置状态\\n */\\nconst AIRoleConfigInfoBox: React.FC&amp;lt;AIRoleConfigInfoBoxProps&amp;gt; = ({ roles, onRefresh, hideHeader = false }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);\\n  const [nodeStatuses, setNodeStatuses] = useState&amp;lt;NodeConfigStatus[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadNodeStatuses();\\n  }, [roles]);\\n\\n  const loadNodeStatuses = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setLoading(true);\\n    try {\\n      const statuses: NodeConfigStatus[] = [];\\n\\n      // 1. 独立页面节点（已删除 node/* 功能子页面，不再显示）\\n      // 这些节点对应的页面已删除，因此不再在配置信息框中显示\\n\\n      // 2. 工作流Agent节点（需要检查工作流中的agent节点）\\n      // 这里可以通过API获取工作流信息，暂时显示提示\\n      statuses.push({\\n        nodeType: 'workflow-agent',\\n        nodeName: '工作流Agent节点',\\n        icon: &amp;lt;Workflow className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;,\\n        configured: false, // 需要从工作流API获取实际状态\\n        source: 'workflow',\\n        path: '/agent-workflow'\\n      });\\n\\n      // 3. 字段映射功能对象（需要检查字段映射配置）\\n      const featureTypes = [\\n        { type: 'five-view-analysis', name: '技术转译（五看）', label: '五看分析' },\\n        { type: 'three-fix-analysis', name: '用户场景挖掘（三定）', label: '三定分析' },\\n        { type: 'tech-matrix', name: '技术矩阵', label: '技术矩阵' },\\n        { type: 'propagation-strategy', name: '传播策略', label: '传播策略' },\\n        { type: 'exhibition-video', name: '展具与视频', label: '展具与视频' },\\n        { type: 'translation', name: '翻译', label: '翻译' },\\n        { type: 'ppt-outline', name: '技术讲稿', label: '技术讲稿' },\\n        { type: 'script', name: '脚本', label: '脚本' },\\n      ];\\n\\n      // 从字段映射配置中获取agentId配置状态\\n;\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 8850,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import React from 'react';\\nimport { Bot, Workflow, MessageSquare, ExternalLink, Sparkles, Settings as SettingsIcon } from 'lucide-react';\\nimport TopNavigation from '../components/TopNavigation';\\nimport { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\\n\\n/**\\n * AI统一管理页面\\n * 整合AI角色、工作流、多窗口对话、公开页面四个核心功能的统一入口\\n */\\nconst AIUnifiedManagementPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n\\n  const managementModules = [\\n    {\\n      id: 'roles',\\n      title: 'AI角色管理',\\n      description: '创建和管理AI对话角色，关联Dify工作流配置',\\n      icon: Bot,\\n      color: 'blue',\\n      path: '/ai-roles',\\n      badge: '基础层',\\n      features: [\\n        '创建和配置AI角色',\\n        '关联Dify服务器工作流',\\n        '管理角色启用状态',\\n        '测试Dify连接',\\n      ],\\n    },\\n    {\\n      id: 'workflow',\\n      title: 'Agent工作流',\\n      description: '基于AI角色进行流程编排，创建智能工作流',\\n      icon: Workflow,\\n      color: 'green',\\n      path: '/agent-workflow',\\n      badge: '编排层',\\n      features: [\\n        '可视化工作流设计',\\n        '节点编排和连接',\\n        '工作流执行和测试',\\n        '模板管理',\\n      ],\\n    },\\n    {\\n      id: 'chat',\\n      title: '多窗口对话',\\n      description: '创建AI对话窗口，关联AI角色或Agent工作流',\\n      icon: MessageSquare,\\n      color: 'purple',\\n      path: '/ai-chat-multi',\\n      badge: '应用层',\\n      features: [\\n        '多窗口并发对话',\\n        '工作流模式支持',\\n        '实时对话交互',\\n        '工作流执行监控',\\n      ],\\n    },\\n    {\\n      id: 'public',\\n      title: '公开页面配置',\\n,\\n  ];\\n;\","

   pattern.test(role.id) || \\n            pattern.test(role.name) || \\n            pattern.test(role.description || '')\\n          )\\n        );\\n\\n        let icon: React.ReactNode;\\n case 'promotion-strategy':\\n            icon = &amp;lt;Target className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;;\\n            path = '/node/promotion-strategy';\\n            break;\\n          case POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\n\\n## 八、关键特性\\n\\n1. **多Provider支持**: 支持Dify和Direct Agent两种类型\\n2. **多轮对话**: 支持conversationId传递，实现多轮对话\\n3. **工具调用**: 支持Function Calling，包括嵌套Agent调用\\n4. **工作流编排**: 支持复杂的工作流编排，Agent节点可嵌入工作流\\n5. **上下文管理**: 支持多种上下文管理策略（窗口、摘要等）\\n6. **字段映射**: 支持输入输出字段映射配置\\n7. **超时控制**: 支持执行超时控制\\n8. **错误重试**: 支持错误重试机制\\n\\n## 九、总结\\n\\n本项目共有**37个**主要的AI/Agent调用节点，分布在：\\n- 后端服务层：15个\\n- 前端服务层：10个\\n- 页面/组件层：8个\\n- API路由层：4个\\n\\n这些调用节点形成了一个完整的AI/Agent调用体系，支持多种使用场景和调用方式。\","

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"# 项目AI/Agent调用节点完整识别\\\\n\\\\n本文档完整识别了todify3项目中所有的AI/Agent调用节点。\\\\n\\\\n## 一、后端服务层调用节点\\\\n\\\\n### 1. AgentOrchestrator（Agent编排器）\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **功能**: 执行Direct Agent类型的AI角色\\\\n- **调用方法**: &amp;amp;#96;executeAgent(roleId, query, conversationId, context)&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **特点**: \\\\n  - 支持工具调用（Function Calling）\\\\n  - 支持多轮对话\\\\n  - 支持上下文管理\\\\n  - 支持Prompt变量替换\\\\n- **使用场景**: Direct Agent类型的AI角色对话\\\\n\\\\n### 2. AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;amp;#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&amp;amp;#96; - 直接执行AI角色\\\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\\\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\\\\n  \\\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;amp;#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&amp;amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\\\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\\\\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\\\\n  \\\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;amp;#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&amp;amp;#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\\\\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\\\\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\\\\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\\\n\\\\n### 3. DifyClient（Dify客户端）\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/DifyClient.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, conversationId)&amp;amp;#96; - AI搜索\\\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;amp;#96;techPackage(inputs)&amp;amp;#96; - 技术包装\\\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs)&amp;amp;#96; - 技术策略\\\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;amp;#96;techArticle(inputs)&amp;amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs)&amp;amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;amp;#96;techPublish(inputs, conversationId)&amp;amp;#96; - 技术发布\\\\n- **调用节点7**: &amp;amp;#96;callApp(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;amp;#96; - 通用应用调用\\\\n- **调用节点8**: &amp;amp;#96;runWorkflow(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;amp;#96; - 工作流调用\\\\n\\\\n### 4. TriggerAgentUseCase（触发Agent用例）\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/TriggerAgent.usecase.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **功能**: 触发子Agent执行（五看、三定、技术矩阵等）\\\\n- **调用方式**: \\\\n  - 通过&amp;amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;amp;#96;直接调用AI角色\\\\n  - 通过&amp;amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;amp;#96;调用工作流\\\\n- **支持的功能类型**:\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;five-view-analysis&amp;amp;#96; - 技术转译（五看）\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;three-fix-analysis&amp;amp;#96; - 用户场景挖掘（三定）\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;tech-matrix&amp;amp;#96; - 技术矩阵\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;propagation-strategy&amp;amp;#96; - 传播策略\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;exhibition-video&amp;amp;#96; - 展具与视频\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;translation&amp;amp;#96; - 翻译\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;ppt-outline&amp;amp;#96; - 技术讲稿\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;script&amp;amp;#96; - 脚本\\\\n\\\\n### 5. ToolExecutor（工具执行器）\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;amp;#96;executeTool(toolCall, toolConfig)&amp;amp;#96; - 执行工具调用\\\\n- **支持的工具类型**:\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;search&amp;amp;#96; - 搜索工具\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;calculation&amp;amp;#96; - 计算工具\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;time&amp;amp;#96; - 时间工具\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;api&amp;amp;#96; - API调用工具\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;workflow&amp;amp;#96; - 工作流调用工具\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;agent&amp;amp;#96; - Agent调用工具（嵌套Agent调用）\\\\n\\\\n## 二、前端服务层调用节点\\\\n\\\\n### 1. workflowAPI（工作流API）\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;#96;frontend/src/services/api.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;amp;#96; - AI搜索\\\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;amp;#96;smartSearch(query, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;amp;#96; - 智能搜索\\\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;amp;#96;techPackage(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;amp;#96; - 技术包装\\\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;amp;#96; - 技术策略\\\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;amp;#96;techArticle(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\\\n\\\\n### 2. aiRoleService（AI角色服务）\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiRoleService.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;amp;#96;chatWithRole(roleId, query, inputs)&amp;amp;#96; - 与AI角色对话\\\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\\\n  - 自动根据角色配置选择调用方式\\\\n\\\\n### 3. aiSearchService（AI搜索服务）\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiSearchService.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;amp;#96;triggerFeatureAgent(conversationId, payload)&amp;amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\\\n  - 用于触发子Agent（五看、三定等）\\\\n  - 支持上下文窗口大小配置\\\\n\\\\n### 4. WorkflowEngine（工作流引擎）\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;#96;frontend/src/services/workflowEngine.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;amp;#96;callAgent(agent, input)&amp;amp;#96; - 调用Agent\\\\n  - 通过&amp;amp;#96;aiRoleService.chatWithRole()&amp;amp;#96;调用\\\\n  - 用于前端工作流执行\\\\n\\\\n## 三、前端页面/组件层调用节点\\\\n\\\\n### 1. POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 八、关键特性\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n1. **多Provider支持**: 支持Dify和Direct Agent两种类型\\\\\\\\n2. **多轮对话**: 支持conversationId传递，实现多轮对话\\\\\\\\n3. **工具调用**: 支持Function Calling，包括嵌套Agent调用\\\\\\\\n4. **工作流编排**: 支持复杂的工作流编排，Agent节点可嵌入工作流\\\\\\\\n5. **上下文管理**: 支持多种上下文管理策略（窗口、摘要等）\\\\\\\\n6. **字段映射**: 支持输入输出字段映射配置\\\\\\\\n7. **超时控制**: 支持执行超时控制\\\\\\\\n8. **错误重试**: 支持错误重试机制\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 九、总结\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n本项目共有**37个**主要的AI/Agent调用节点，分布在：\\\\\\\\n- 后端服务层：15个\\\\\\\\n- 前端服务层：10个\\\\\\\\n- 页面/组件层：8个\\\\\\\\n- API路由层：4个\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n这些调用节点形成了一个完整的AI/Agent调用体系，支持多种使用场景和调用方式。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\"\""

AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\\\\\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;amp;amp;#96;\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 直接执行AI角色\\\\\\\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\\\\\\\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\\\\\\\\n  \\\\\\\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\\\\\\\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\\\\\\\\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\\\\\\\\n  \\\\\\\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\\\\\\\\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\\\\\\\\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\\\\\\\\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 3. DifyClient（Dify客户端）\\\\\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/DifyClient.ts&amp;amp;amp;#96;\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, conversationId)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - AI搜索\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;techPackage(inputs)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 技术包装\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 技术策略\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;techArticle(inputs)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;techPublish(inputs, conversationId)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 技术发布\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点7**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;callApp(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 通用应用调用\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点8**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;runWorkflow(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 工作流调用\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 4. POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 八、关键特性\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n1. **多Provider支持**: 支持Dify和Direct Agent两种类型\\\\\\\\n2. **多轮对话**: 支持conversationId传递，实现多轮对话\\\\\\\\n3. **工具调用**: 支持Function Calling，包括嵌套Agent调用\\\\\\\\n4. **工作流编排**: 支持复杂的工作流编排，Agent节点可嵌入工作流\\\\\\\\n5. **上下文管理**: 支持多种上下文管理策略（窗口、摘要等）\\\\\\\\n6. **字段映射**: 支持输入输出字段映射配置\\\\\\\\n7. **超时控制**: 支持执行超时控制\\\\\\\\n8. **错误重试**: 支持错误重试机制\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 九、总结\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n本项目共有**37个**主要的AI/Agent调用节点，分布在：\\\\\\\\n- 后端服务层：15个\\\\\\\\n- 前端服务层：10个\\\\\\\\n- 页面/组件层：8个\\\\\\\\n- API路由层：4个\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n这些调用节点形成了一个完整的AI/Agent调用体系，支持多种使用场景和调用方式。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\"\""

AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\\\\\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;amp;amp;#96;\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 直接执行AI角色\\\\\\\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\\\\\\\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\\\\\\\\n  \\\\\\\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\\\\\\\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\\\\\\\\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\\\\\\\\n  \\\\\\\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\\\\\\\\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\\\\\\\\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\\\\\\\\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 3. POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 八、关键特性\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n1. **多Provider支持**: 支持Dify和Direct Agent两种类型\\\\\\\\n2. **多轮对话**: 支持conversationId传递，实现多轮对话\\\\\\\\n3. **工具调用**: 支持Function Calling，包括嵌套Agent调用\\\\\\\\n4. **工作流编排**: 支持复杂的工作流编排，Agent节点可嵌入工作流\\\\\\\\n5. **上下文管理**: 支持多种上下文管理策略（窗口、摘要等）\\\\\\\\n6. **字段映射**: 支持输入输出字段映射配置\\\\\\\\n7. **超时控制**: 支持执行超时控制\\\\\\\\n8. **错误重试**: 支持错误重试机制\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 九、总结\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n本项目共有**37个**主要的AI/Agent调用节点，分布在：\\\\\\\\n- 后端服务层：15个\\\\\\\\n- 前端服务层：10个\\\\\\\\n- 页面/组件层：8个\\\\\\\\n- API路由层：4个\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n这些调用节点形成了一个完整的AI/Agent调用体系，支持多种使用场景和调用方式。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\"\""

AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\\\\\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;amp;amp;#96;\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 直接执行AI角色\\\\\\\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\\\\\\\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\\\\\\\\n  \\\\\\\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\\\\\\\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\\\\\\\\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\\\\\\\\n  \\\\\\\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\\\\\\\\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\\\\\\\\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\\\\\\\\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 3. DifyClient（Dify客户端）\\\\\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/DifyClient.ts&amp;amp;amp;#96;\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, conversationId)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - AI搜索\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;techPackage(inputs)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 技术包装\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 技术策略\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;techArticle(inputs)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;techPublish(inputs, conversationId)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 技术发布\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点7**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;callApp(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 通用应用调用\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点8**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;runWorkflow(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 工作流调用\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 4. POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 八、关键特性\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n1. **多Provider支持**: 支持Dify和Direct Agent两种类型\\\\\\\\n2. **多轮对话**: 支持conversationId传递，实现多轮对话\\\\\\\\n3. **工具调用**: 支持Function Calling，包括嵌套Agent调用\\\\\\\\n4. **工作流编排**: 支持复杂的工作流编排，Agent节点可嵌入工作流\\\\\\\\n5. **上下文管理**: 支持多种上下文管理策略（窗口、摘要等）\\\\\\\\n6. **字段映射**: 支持输入输出字段映射配置\\\\\\\\n7. **超时控制**: 支持执行超时控制\\\\\\\\n8. **错误重试**: 支持错误重试机制\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 九、总结\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n本项目共有**37个**主要的AI/Agent调用节点，分布在：\\\\\\\\n- 后端服务层：15个\\\\\\\\n- 前端服务层：10个\\\\\\\\n- 页面/组件层：8个\\\\\\\\n- API路由层：4个\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n这些调用节点形成了一个完整的AI/Agent调用体系，支持多种使用场景和调用方式。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\"\""

AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\\\\\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;amp;amp;#96;\\\\\\\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 直接执行AI角色\\\\\\\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\\\\\\\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\\\\\\\\n  \\\\\\\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\\\\\\\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\\\\\\\\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\\\\\\\\n  \\\\\\\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;amp;amp;#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&amp;amp;amp;#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\\\\\\\\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\\\\\\\\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\\\\\\\\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 3. POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 八、关键特性\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n1. **多Provider支持**: 支持Dify和Direct Agent两种类型\\\\\\\\n2. **多轮对话**: 支持conversationId传递，实现多轮对话\\\\\\\\n3. **工具调用**: 支持Function Calling，包括嵌套Agent调用\\\\\\\\n4. **工作流编排**: 支持复杂的工作流编排，Agent节点可嵌入工作流\\\\\\\\n5. **上下文管理**: 支持多种上下文管理策略（窗口、摘要等）\\\\\\\\n6. **字段映射**: 支持输入输出字段映射配置\\\\\\\\n7. **超时控制**: 支持执行超时控制\\\\\\\\n8. **错误重试**: 支持错误重试机制\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 九、总结\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n本项目共有**37个**主要的AI/Agent调用节点，分布在：\\\\\\\\n- 后端服务层：15个\\\\\\\\n- 前端服务层：10个\\\\\\\\n- 页面/组件层：8个\\\\\\\\n- API路由层：4个\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n这些调用节点形成了一个完整的AI/Agent调用体系，支持多种使用场景和调用方式。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\"\""

AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;amp;#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&amp;amp;#96; - 直接执行AI角色\\\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\\\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\\\\n  \\\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;amp;#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&amp;amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\\\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\\\\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\\\\n  \\\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;amp;#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&amp;amp;#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\\\\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\\\\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\\\\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\\\n\\\\n### 3. DifyClient（Dify客户端）\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/DifyClient.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, conversationId)&amp;amp;#96; - AI搜索\\\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;amp;#96;techPackage(inputs)&amp;amp;#96; - 技术包装\\\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs)&amp;amp;#96; - 技术策略\\\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;amp;#96;techArticle(inputs)&amp;amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs)&amp;amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;amp;#96;techPublish(inputs, conversationId)&amp;amp;#96; - 技术发布\\\\n- **调用节点7**: &amp;amp;#96;callApp(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;amp;#96; - 通用应用调用\\\\n- **调用节点8**: &amp;amp;#96;runWorkflow(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;amp;#96; - 工作流调用\\\\n\\\\n### 4. TriggerAgentUseCase（触发Agent用例）\\\\n**位置**: &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/TriggerAgent.usecase.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **功能**: 触发子Agent执行（五看、三定、技术矩阵等）\\\\n- **调用方式**: \\\\n  - 通过&amp;amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;amp;#96;直接调用AI角色\\\\n  - 通过&amp;amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;amp;#96;调用工作流\\\\n- **支持的功能类型**:\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;five-view-analysis&amp;amp;#96; - 技术转译（五看）\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;three-fix-analysis&amp;amp;#96; - 用户场景挖掘（三定）\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;tech-matrix&amp;amp;#96; - 技术矩阵\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;propagation-strategy&amp;amp;#96; - 传播策略\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;exhibition-video&amp;amp;#96; - 展具与视频\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;translation&amp;amp;#96; - 翻译\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;ppt-outline&amp;amp;#96; - 技术讲稿\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;script&amp;amp;#96; - 脚本\\\\n\\\\n### 5. {\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\n    headers: req.headers,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    url: req.url,\\n  });\\n  try {\\n    const response = {\\n      success: true,\\n      message: 'API is running',\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\n    };\\n    res.json(response);\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 简单测试端点\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;gt;                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport {\\\\n  MessageCircle,\\\\n  Target,\\\\n  FileText,\\\\n  Mic,\\\\n  Home,\\\\n  Settings,\\\\n  User,\\\\n  ChevronDown,\\\\n} from \\\\\\\"lucide-react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  label: string;\\\\n  icon: any;\\\\n  path: string;\\\\n  disabled: boolean;\\\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\\\n  configId?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\\\n  '/ai-roles',\\\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\\\n  '/ai-management',\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport {\\\\n  MessageCircle,\\\\n  Target,\\\\n  FileText,\\\\n  Mic,\\\\n  Home,\\\\n  Settings,\\\\n  User,\\\\n  ChevronDown,\\\\n} from \\\\\\\"lucide-react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  label: string;\\\\n  icon: any;\\\\n  path: string;\\\\n  disabled: boolean;\\\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\\\n  configId?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\\\n  '/ai-roles',\\\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\\\n  '/ai-management',\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt;('用户');\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    \\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = (event?: Event) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到配置更新事件:', event);\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = (event?: Event) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到自定义刷新事件:', event);\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 重新计算 mainItems，activeConfigs:', activeConfigs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        console.log(&amp;amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 找到配置 ${navItem.name}:&amp;amp;#96;, config);\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        console.log(&amp;amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 未找到配置 ${navItem.name}，将显示为禁用状态&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 生成的 mainItems:', items.map(i =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: i.id, label: i.label, disabled: i.disabled })));\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      navigate(path);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\\\n    if (path === '/') {\\\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\\\n    }\\\\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\\\\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\\\\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&amp;amp;gt; \\\\n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\\\\n      );\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 精确匹配\\\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return (\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n\\\\n          return (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\\\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\\\n                  ${\\\\n                    item.disabled\\\\n                      ? \\\\\\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                      : isCurrent\\\\n                        ? \\\\\\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"\\\\n                        : \\\\\\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                  }\\\\n                &amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n                title={item.label}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;amp;#96;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                \\\\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                )}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          );\\\\n        })}\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    );\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  return (\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center h-16 justify-between\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          {/* 左侧导航项 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {/* 第一组：项目管理 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            \\\\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n            {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 右侧：加载状态和用户标识 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center gap-4\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\\\n            {loading &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            )}\\\\n\\\\n            {/* 用户标识和下拉菜单 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"relative flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; setUserMenuOpen(!userMenuOpen)}\\\\n                className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-200\\\\\\\"\\\\n                title={currentUsername}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;User className=\\\\\\\"w-4 h-4\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{currentUsername}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;ChevronDown className={&amp;amp;#96;w-4 h-4 transition-transform duration-200 ${userMenuOpen ? 'transform rotate-180' : ''}&amp;amp;#96;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n              {/* 下拉菜单 */}\\\\n              {userMenuOpen &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  {/* 背景遮罩，点击关闭菜单 */}\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div\\\\n                    className=\\\\\\\"fixed inset-0 z-40\\\\\\\"\\\\n                    onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; setUserMenuOpen(false)}\\\\n                  /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  {/* 下拉菜单内容 */}\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"absolute right-0 top-full mt-2 w-48 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 py-1 z-50\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                    {managementItems.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n                      const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n                      const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n                      \\\\n                      return (\\\\n                        &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                          key={item.id}\\\\n                          onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n                            handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id);\\\\n                            setUserMenuOpen(false);\\\\n                          }}\\\\n                          disabled={item.disabled}\\\\n                          className={&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n                            w-full flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium\\\\n                            transition-colors duration-200\\\\n                            ${\\\\n                              item.disabled\\\\n                                ? \\\\\\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                                : isCurrent\\\\n                                  ? \\\\\\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                                  : \\\\\\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                            }\\\\n                          &amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n                        &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                          &amp;amp;lt;Icon className=\\\\\\\"w-4 h-4\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                          &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                        &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                      );\\\\n                    })}\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;/&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              )}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  );\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\\\n\\\",\""

{\\\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\\\n    headers: req.headers,\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    url: req.url,\\\\n  });\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const response = {\\\\n      success: true,\\\\n      message: 'API is running',\\\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\\\n    };\\\\n    res.json(response);\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\\\n    res.status(500).json({\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\\\n    });\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 简单测试端点\\\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import axios from 'axios';\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from '../types/aiRole';\\n\\nconst API_BASE_URL = '/api/v1';\\n\\nconst api = axios.create({\\n  baseURL: API_BASE_URL,\\n  timeout: 120_000, // 增加到120秒（2分钟），适应AI请求的较长响应时间\\n  headers: {\\n    'Content-Type': 'application/json',\\n  },\\n});\\n\\nexport interface AIRoleResponse {\\n  success: boolean;\\n  data?: any;\\n  message?: string;\\n  error?: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface AIRoleUsageLocation {\\n  type: 'independent-page' | 'agent-workflow' | 'multi-chat' | 'workflow-editor';\\n  name: string;\\n  path?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  nodeId?: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface AIRoleUsage {\\n  roleId: string;\\n  roleName: string;\\n  locations: AIRoleUsageLocation[];\\n  totalUsageCount: number;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface ChatResponse {\\n  success: boolean;\\n  data?: {\\n    answer?: string;\\n    result?: string;\\n    conversation_id?: string;\\n    metadata?: any;\\n  };\\n  message?: string;\\n  error?: string;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * AI角色服务\\n */\\nclass AIRoleService {\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有AI角色\\n   */\\n  async getAIRoles(): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleConfig[]&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get('/ai-roles');\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        return response.data.data.map((role: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n          ...role,\\n          createdAt: new Date(role.createdAt),\\n          updatedAt: new Date(role.updatedAt),\\n        }));\\n      }\\n      return [];\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      \\n      // 对于404、500错误或连接错误（后端未运行），静默处理，不输出任何日志\\n      // 这是正常情况，不需要记录\\n      if (errorStatus === 404 || errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        // 静默失败，返回空数组\\n        return [];\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 其他错误才输出详细信息\\n      const errorMessage = error?.response?.data?.message || error?.message || '未知错误';\\n      const errorUrl = error?.config?.url || error?.request?.responseURL;\\n      const errorBaseURL = error?.config?.baseURL;\\n      console.error('🔴 [aiRoleService] 获取AI角色列表失败');\\n      console.error('错误消息:', errorMessage);\\n      console.error('HTTP状态码:', errorStatus);\\n      console.error('请求URL:', errorUrl);\\n      console.error('Base URL:', errorBaseURL);\\n      \\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取单个AI角色\\n   */\\n  async getAIRole(id: string): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleConfig | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/ai-roles/${id}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        const role = response.data.data;\\n        return {\\n          ...role,\\n          createdAt: new Date(role.createdAt),\\n          updatedAt: new Date(role.updatedAt),\\n        };\\n      }\\n      return null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取AI角色失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 创建AI角色\\n   */\\n  async createAIRole(config: Omit&amp;lt;AIRoleConfig, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'&amp;gt;): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleResponse&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post('/ai-roles', config);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('创建AI角色失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '创建AI角色失败',\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新AI角色\\n   */\\n  async updateAIRole(id: string, updates: Partial&amp;lt;AIRoleConfig&amp;gt;): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleResponse&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.put(&amp;#96;/ai-roles/${id}&amp;#96;, updates);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('更新AI角色失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '更新AI角色失败',\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除AI角色\\n   */\\n  async deleteAIRole(id: string): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleResponse&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.delete(&amp;#96;/ai-roles/${id}&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\","

{\\\\\\\\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\\\\\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\\\\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\\\\\\\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\\\\\\\\n    path: req.path,\\\\\\\\n    params: req.params,\\\\\\\\n    query: req.query,\\\\\\\\n    body: req.body,\\\\\\\\n  });\\\\\\\\n  next();\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n// 注册路由\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/projects', projectsRouter);\\\\\\\\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n// 健康检查\\\\\\\\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\\\\\\\n    headers: req.headers,\\\\\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\\\\\n    url: req.url,\\\\\\\\n  });\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const response = {\\\\\\\\n      success: true,\\\\\\\\n      message: 'API is running',\\\\\\\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\\\\\\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n    res.json(response);\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json({\\\\\\\\n      success: false,\\\\\\\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\\\\\\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n// 简单测试端点\\\\\\\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  logger.debug('Test endpoint called');\\\\\\\\n  res.json({\\\\\\\\n    success: true,\\\\\\\\n    message: 'Test endpoint working',\\\\\\\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\\\\\\\\n  });\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n// 404 处理中间件（必须在所有路由之后）\\\\\\\\nrouter.use((req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  logger.warn('API 路由未找到', {\\\\\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\\\\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\\\\\\\n    path: req.path,\\\\\\\\n  });\\\\\\\\n  res.status(404).json({\\\\\\\\n    success: false,\\\\\\\\n    error: {\\\\\\\\n      code: 'NOT_FOUND',\\\\\\\\n      message: &amp;amp;amp;#96;路由不存在: ${req.method} ${req.path}&amp;amp;amp;#96;,\\\\\\\\n    },\\\\\\\\n  });\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nexport default router;\\\\\\\",\\\"\""

{\\\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\\\n    headers: req.headers,\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    url: req.url,\\\\n  });\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const response = {\\\\n      success: true,\\\\n      message: 'API is running',\\\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\\\n    };\\\\n    res.json(response);\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\\\n    res.status(500).json({\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\\\n    });\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 简单测试端点\\\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.warn('API 路由未找到', {\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\\\n    path: req.path,\\\\n  });\\\\n  res.status(404).json({\\\\n    success: false,\\\\n    error: {\\\\n      code: 'NOT_FOUND',\\\\n      message: &amp;amp;#96;路由不存在: ${req.method} ${req.path}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n    },\\\\n  });\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\nexport default router;\\\",\""

{\\\\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\\\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\\\\n    path: req.path,\\\\n    params: req.params,\\\\n    query: req.query,\\\\n    body: req.body,\\\\n  });\\\\n  next();\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 注册路由\\\\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\\\\n\\\\n// 健康检查\\\\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\\\n    headers: req.headers,\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    url: req.url,\\\\n  });\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const response = {\\\\n      success: true,\\\\n      message: 'API is running',\\\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\\\n    };\\\\n    res.json(response);\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\\\n    res.status(500).json({\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\\\n    });\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 简单测试端点\\\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.debug('Test endpoint called');\\\\n  res.json({\\\\n    success: true,\\\\n    message: 'Test endpoint working',\\\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\\\\n  });\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 404 处理中间件（必须在所有路由之后）\\\\nrouter.use((req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.warn('API 路由未找到', {\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\\\n    path: req.path,\\\\n  });\\\\n  res.status(404).json({\\\\n    success: false,\\\\n    error: {\\\\n      code: 'NOT_FOUND',\\\\n      message: &amp;amp;#96;路由不存在: ${req.method} ${req.path}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n    },\\\\n  });\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\nexport default router;\\\",\""

/&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;/Routes&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;/Router&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  );\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nexport default App;\\\\n\\\",\""

                  "lineNumber": 45820,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * 执行Agent工作流\\n * POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\n */\\nrouter.post('/:id/execute', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const { input, options } = req.body;\\n    \\n    const result = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(id, {\\n      input,\\n      ...options,\\n    });\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, result, '工作流执行已开始'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('执行工作流失败:', error);\\n    \\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;amp;&amp;amp; error.message.includes('不存在')) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, error.message));\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '执行工作流失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取工作流执行历史\\n * GET /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/executions\\n */\","
