= ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt;('用户');\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    \\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = (event?: Event) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到配置更新事件:', event);\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = (event?: Event) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到自定义刷新事件:', event);\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 重新计算 mainItems，activeConfigs:', activeConfigs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        console.log(&amp;amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 找到配置 ${navItem.name}:&amp;amp;#96;, config);\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        console.log(&amp;amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 未找到配置 ${navItem.name}，将显示为禁用状态&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 生成的 mainItems:', items.map(i =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: i.id, label: i.label, disabled: i.disabled })));\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      navigate(path);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"# 项目AI/Agent调用节点完整识别\\n\\n本文档完整识别了todify3项目中所有的AI/Agent调用节点。\\n\\n## 一、后端服务层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. AgentOrchestrator（Agent编排器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 执行Direct Agent类型的AI角色\\n- **调用方法**: &amp;#96;executeAgent(roleId, query, conversationId, context)&amp;#96;\\n- **特点**: \\n  - 支持工具调用（Function Calling）\\n  - 支持多轮对话\\n  - 支持上下文管理\\n  - 支持Prompt变量替换\\n- **使用场景**: Direct Agent类型的AI角色对话\\n\\n### 2. AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&amp;#96; - 直接执行AI角色\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\\n  \\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\\n  \\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&amp;#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\n\\n### 3. DifyClient（Dify客户端）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/DifyClient.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;techPublish(inputs, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 技术发布\\n- **调用节点7**: &amp;#96;callApp(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;#96; - 通用应用调用\\n- **调用节点8**: &amp;#96;runWorkflow(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;#96; - 工作流调用\\n\\n### 4. TriggerAgentUseCase（触发Agent用例）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/TriggerAgent.usecase.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 触发子Agent执行（五看、三定、技术矩阵等）\\n- **调用方式**: \\n  - 通过&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;#96;直接调用AI角色\\n  - 通过&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;调用工作流\\n- **支持的功能类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;five-view-analysis&amp;#96; - 技术转译（五看）\\n  - &amp;#96;three-fix-analysis&amp;#96; - 用户场景挖掘（三定）\\n  - &amp;#96;tech-matrix&amp;#96; - 技术矩阵\\n  - &amp;#96;propagation-strategy&amp;#96; - 传播策略\\n  - &amp;#96;exhibition-video&amp;#96; - 展具与视频\\n  - &amp;#96;translation&amp;#96; - 翻译\\n  - &amp;#96;ppt-outline&amp;#96; - 技术讲稿\\n  - &amp;#96;script&amp;#96; - 脚本\\n\\n### 5. ToolExecutor（工具执行器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;executeTool(toolCall, toolConfig)&amp;#96; - 执行工具调用\\n- **支持的工具类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;search&amp;#96; - 搜索工具\\n  - &amp;#96;calculation&amp;#96; - 计算工具\\n  - &amp;#96;time&amp;#96; - 时间工具\\n  - &amp;#96;api&amp;#96; - API调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;workflow&amp;#96; - 工作流调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96; - Agent调用工具（嵌套Agent调用）\\n\\n## 二、前端服务层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. workflowAPI（工作流API）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/api.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;smartSearch(query, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 智能搜索\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n\\n### 2. aiRoleService（AI角色服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiRoleService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;chatWithRole(roleId, query, inputs)&amp;#96; - 与AI角色对话\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 自动根据角色配置选择调用方式\\n\\n### 3. aiSearchService（AI搜索服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiSearchService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;triggerFeatureAgent(conversationId, payload)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 用于触发子Agent（五看、三定等）\\n  - 支持上下文窗口大小配置\\n\\n### 4. WorkflowEngine（工作流引擎）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/workflowEngine.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;callAgent(agent, input)&amp;#96; - 调用Agent\\n  - 通过&amp;#96;aiRoleService.chatWithRole()&amp;#96;调用\\n  - 用于前端工作流执行\\n\\n## 三、前端页面/组件层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. BaseAISearchPage（基础AI搜索页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/ai-search/BaseAISearchPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleTriggerFeature(featureType)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;aiSearchService.triggerFeatureAgent()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持的功能类型：五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播策略等\\n\\n### 2. AIChatPage（AI聊天页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/AIChatPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleSendMessage()&amp;#96; - 发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持多轮对话\\n\\n### 3. ProjectResourcesPage（项目资源页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleAISendMessage()&amp;#96; - AI问答发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持项目资源上下文\\n\\n### 4. AiSearchComponent（AI搜索组件）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/AiSearchComponent.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleAiSearch()&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 5. 独立节点组件\\n以下节点组件都包含AI调用：\\n\\n#### AiSearchNode（AI搜索节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/AiSearchNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### TechPackageNode（技术包装节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/TechPackageNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.techPackage()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### CoreDraftNode（核心稿件节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/CoreDraftNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.coreDraft()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### PromotionStrategyNode（推广策略节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/PromotionStrategyNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.techStrategy()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### PressReleaseNode（新闻稿节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/PressReleaseNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用相关AI服务\\n\\n#### TechNewsletterNode（技术通讯节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/TechNewsletterNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用相关AI服务\\n\\n## 四、后端API路由层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. AI角色路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/aiRole.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat&amp;#96;\\n  - 根据provider类型调用：\\n    - Direct Agent: &amp;#96;AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent()&amp;#96;\\n    - Dify: &amp;#96;DifyGateway.executeChat()&amp;#96; 或 &amp;#96;DifyGateway.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2. AI搜索路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由1**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages&amp;#96; - 发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;SendMessageUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n  \\n- **路由2**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents&amp;#96; - 触发子Agent\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;TriggerAgentUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3. 工作流路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/agentWorkflow.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由1**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute&amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;\\n  \\n- **路由2**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/roles/:id/execute&amp;#96; - 执行AI角色\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 4. 工作流API路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/workflow/api/workflow.routes.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/workflow/ai-search&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;ExecuteAiSearchUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 五、工作流节点类型\\n\\n### 1. Agent节点（工作流编辑器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/AgentNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **类型**: &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 在工作流中调用AI角色\\n- **执行**: 通过后端&amp;#96;AgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()&amp;#96;执行\\n\\n### 2. 其他工作流节点类型\\n- &amp;#96;input&amp;#96; - 输入节点\\n- &amp;#96;output&amp;#96; - 输出节点\\n- &amp;#96;condition&amp;#96; - 条件判断节点\\n- &amp;#96;assign&amp;#96; - 变量赋值节点\\n- &amp;#96;merge&amp;#96; - 数据合并节点\\n- &amp;#96;transform&amp;#96; - 数据转换节点\\n- &amp;#96;memory&amp;#96; - 文本记忆节点\\n\\n## 六、调用链路总结\\n\\n### 链路1: 前端页面 → 前端服务 → 后端API → 后端服务 → Dify/LLM\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n前端页面组件\\n  ↓\\n前端服务层 (workflowAPI/aiRoleService/aiSearchService)\\n  ↓\\n后端API路由层\\n  ↓\\n后端服务层 (AgentWorkflowService/DifyClient/AgentOrchestrator)\\n  ↓\\nDify Gateway / LLM Provider\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 链路2: 工作流执行 → Agent节点 → AI角色\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n工作流执行\\n  ↓\\nAgent节点\\n  ↓\\nAgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()\\n  ↓\\nAI角色配置 (Dify/Direct Agent)\\n  ↓\\nDify Gateway / AgentOrchestrator\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 链路3: 工具调用 → Agent嵌套调用\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\nLLM工具调用\\n  ↓\\nToolExecutor.executeTool()\\n  ↓\\nAgent工具类型\\n  ↓\\nAgentOrchestrator.executeAgent() (嵌套调用)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 七、AI/Agent调用节点统计\\n\\n### 后端调用节点（共15个）\\n1. AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent()\\n2. AgentWorkflowService.executeRole()\\n3. AgentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()\\n4. AgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()\\n5. DifyClient.aiSearch()\\n6. DifyClient.techPackage()\\n7. DifyClient.techStrategy()\\n8. DifyClient.techArticle()\\n9. DifyClient.coreDraft()\\n10. DifyClient.techPublish()\\n11. DifyClient.callApp()\\n12. DifyClient.runWorkflow()\\n13. TriggerAgentUseCase.execute()\\n14. ToolExecutor.executeTool() (agent类型)\\n15. SendMessageUseCase.execute()\\n\\n### 前端调用节点（共10个）\\n1. workflowAPI.aiSearch()\\n2. workflowAPI.smartSearch()\\n3. workflowAPI.techPackage()\\n4. workflowAPI.techStrategy()\\n5. workflowAPI.techArticle()\\n6. workflowAPI.coreDraft()\\n7. aiRoleService.chatWithRole()\\n8. aiSearchService.triggerFeatureAgent()\\n9. WorkflowEngine.callAgent()\\n10. 各节点组件的AI调用方法\\n\\n### 页面/组件调用节点（共8个）\\n1. BaseAISearchPage.handleTriggerFeature()\\n2. AIChatPage.handleSendMessage()\\n3. ProjectResourcesPage.handleAISendMessage()\\n4. AiSearchComponent.handleAiSearch()\\n5. AiSearchNode的AI调用\\n6. TechPackageNode的AI调用\\n7. CoreDraftNode的AI调用\\n8. PromotionStrategyNode的AI调用\\n\\n### API路由调用节点（共4个）\\n1. POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat\\n2. POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\\n3. POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents\\n4. POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\n\\n## 八、关键特性\\n\\n1. **多Provider支持**: 支持Dify和Direct Agent两种类型\\n2. **多轮对话**: 支持conversationId传递，实现多轮对话\\n3. **工具调用**: 支持Function Calling，包括嵌套Agent调用\\n4. **工作流编排**: 支持复杂的工作流编排，Agent节点可嵌入工作流\\n5. **上下文管理**: 支持多种上下文管理策略（窗口、摘要等）\\n6. **字段映射**: 支持输入输出字段映射配置\\n7. **超时控制**: 支持执行超时控制\\n8. **错误重试**: 支持错误重试机制\\n\\n## 九、总结\\n\\n本项目共有**37个**主要的AI/Agent调用节点，分布在：\\n- 后端服务层：15个\\n- 前端服务层：10个\\n- 页面/组件层：8个\\n- API路由层：4个\\n\\n这些调用节点形成了一个完整的AI/Agent调用体系，支持多种使用场景和调用方式。\\n\","

= ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt;('用户');\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    \\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = (event?: Event) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到配置更新事件:', event);\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = (event?: Event) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到自定义刷新事件:', event);\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 重新计算 mainItems，activeConfigs:', activeConfigs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        console.log(&amp;amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 找到配置 ${navItem.name}:&amp;amp;#96;, config);\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        console.log(&amp;amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 未找到配置 ${navItem.name}，将显示为禁用状态&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 生成的 mainItems:', items.map(i =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: i.id, label: i.label, disabled: i.disabled })));\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      navigate(path);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"# 项目AI/Agent调用节点完整识别\\n\\n本文档完整识别了todify3项目中所有的AI/Agent调用节点。\\n\\n## 一、后端服务层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. AgentOrchestrator（Agent编排器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 执行Direct Agent类型的AI角色\\n- **调用方法**: &amp;#96;executeAgent(roleId, query, conversationId, context)&amp;#96;\\n- **特点**: \\n  - 支持工具调用（Function Calling）\\n  - 支持多轮对话\\n  - 支持上下文管理\\n  - 支持Prompt变量替换\\n- **使用场景**: Direct Agent类型的AI角色对话\\n\\n### 2. AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&amp;#96; - 直接执行AI角色\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\\n  \\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\\n  \\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&amp;#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\n\\n### 3. DifyClient（Dify客户端）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/DifyClient.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;techPublish(inputs, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 技术发布\\n- **调用节点7**: &amp;#96;callApp(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;#96; - 通用应用调用\\n- **调用节点8**: &amp;#96;runWorkflow(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;#96; - 工作流调用\\n\\n### 4. TriggerAgentUseCase（触发Agent用例）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/TriggerAgent.usecase.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 触发子Agent执行（五看、三定、技术矩阵等）\\n- **调用方式**: \\n  - 通过&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;#96;直接调用AI角色\\n  - 通过&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;调用工作流\\n- **支持的功能类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;five-view-analysis&amp;#96; - 技术转译（五看）\\n  - &amp;#96;three-fix-analysis&amp;#96; - 用户场景挖掘（三定）\\n  - &amp;#96;tech-matrix&amp;#96; - 技术矩阵\\n  - &amp;#96;propagation-strategy&amp;#96; - 传播策略\\n  - &amp;#96;exhibition-video&amp;#96; - 展具与视频\\n  - &amp;#96;translation&amp;#96; - 翻译\\n  - &amp;#96;ppt-outline&amp;#96; - 技术讲稿\\n  - &amp;#96;script&amp;#96; - 脚本\\n\\n### 5. ToolExecutor（工具执行器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;executeTool(toolCall, toolConfig)&amp;#96; - 执行工具调用\\n- **支持的工具类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;search&amp;#96; - 搜索工具\\n  - &amp;#96;calculation&amp;#96; - 计算工具\\n  - &amp;#96;time&amp;#96; - 时间工具\\n  - &amp;#96;api&amp;#96; - API调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;workflow&amp;#96; - 工作流调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96; - Agent调用工具（嵌套Agent调用）\\n\\n## 二、前端服务层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. workflowAPI（工作流API）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/api.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;smartSearch(query, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 智能搜索\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n\\n### 2. aiRoleService（AI角色服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiRoleService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;chatWithRole(roleId, query, inputs)&amp;#96; - 与AI角色对话\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 自动根据角色配置选择调用方式\\n\\n### 3. aiSearchService（AI搜索服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiSearchService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;triggerFeatureAgent(conversationId, payload)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 用于触发子Agent（五看、三定等）\\n  - 支持上下文窗口大小配置\\n\\n### 4. WorkflowEngine（工作流引擎）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/workflowEngine.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;callAgent(agent, input)&amp;#96; - 调用Agent\\n  - 通过&amp;#96;aiRoleService.chatWithRole()&amp;#96;调用\\n  - 用于前端工作流执行\\n\\n## 三、前端页面/组件层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. BaseAISearchPage（基础AI搜索页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/ai-search/BaseAISearchPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleTriggerFeature(featureType)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;aiSearchService.triggerFeatureAgent()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持的功能类型：五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播策略等\\n\\n### 2. AIChatPage（AI聊天页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/AIChatPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleSendMessage()&amp;#96; - 发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持多轮对话\\n\\n### 3. ProjectResourcesPage（项目资源页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleAISendMessage()&amp;#96; - AI问答发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持项目资源上下文\\n\\n### 4. AiSearchComponent（AI搜索组件）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/AiSearchComponent.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleAiSearch()&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 5. 独立节点组件\\n以下节点组件都包含AI调用：\\n\\n#### AiSearchNode（AI搜索节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/AiSearchNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### TechPackageNode（技术包装节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/TechPackageNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.techPackage()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### CoreDraftNode（核心稿件节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/CoreDraftNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.coreDraft()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### PromotionStrategyNode（推广策略节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/PromotionStrategyNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.techStrategy()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### PressReleaseNode（新闻稿节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/PressReleaseNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用相关AI服务\\n\\n#### TechNewsletterNode（技术通讯节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/TechNewsletterNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用相关AI服务\\n\\n## 四、后端API路由层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. AI角色路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/aiRole.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat&amp;#96;\\n  - 根据provider类型调用：\\n    - Direct Agent: &amp;#96;AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent()&amp;#96;\\n    - Dify: &amp;#96;DifyGateway.executeChat()&amp;#96; 或 &amp;#96;DifyGateway.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2. AI搜索路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由1**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages&amp;#96; - 发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;SendMessageUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n  \\n- **路由2**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents&amp;#96; - 触发子Agent\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;TriggerAgentUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3. 工作流路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/agentWorkflow.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由1**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute&amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;\\n  \\n- **路由2**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/roles/:id/execute&amp;#96; - 执行AI角色\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 4. 工作流API路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/workflow/api/workflow.routes.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/workflow/ai-search&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;ExecuteAiSearchUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 五、工作流节点类型\\n\\n### 1. Agent节点（工作流编辑器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/AgentNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **类型**: &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 在工作流中调用AI角色\\n- **执行**: 通过后端&amp;#96;AgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()&amp;#96;执行\\n\\n### 2. 其他工作流节点类型\\n- &amp;#96;input&amp;#96; - 输入节点\\n- &amp;#96;output&amp;#96; - 输出节点\\n- &amp;#96;condition&amp;#96; - 条件判断节点\\n- &amp;#96;assign&amp;#96; - 变量赋值节点\\n- &amp;#96;merge&amp;#96; - 数据合并节点\\n- &amp;#96;transform&amp;#96; - 数据转换节点\\n- &amp;#96;memory&amp;#96; - 文本记忆节点\\n\\n## 六、调用链路总结\\n\\n### 链路1: 前端页面 → 前端服务 → 后端API → 后端服务 → Dify/LLM\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n前端页面组件\\n  ↓\\n前端服务层 (workflowAPI/aiRoleService/aiSearchService)\\n  ↓\\n后端API路由层\\n  ↓\\n后端服务层 (AgentWorkflowService/DifyClient/AgentOrchestrator)\\n  ↓\\nDify Gateway / LLM Provider\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 链路2: 工作流执行 → Agent节点 → AI角色\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n工作流执行\\n  ↓\\nAgent节点\\n  ↓\\nAgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()\\n  ↓\\nAI角色配置 (Dify/Direct Agent)\\n  ↓\\nDify Gateway / AgentOrchestrator\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 链路3: 工具调用 → Agent嵌套调用\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\nLLM工具调用\\n  ↓\\nToolExecutor.executeTool()\\n  ↓\\nAgent工具类型\\n  ↓\\nAgentOrchestrator.executeAgent() (嵌套调用)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 七、AI/Agent调用节点统计\\n\\n### 后端调用节点（共15个）\\n1. AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent()\\n2. AgentWorkflowService.executeRole()\\n3. AgentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()\\n4. AgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()\\n5. DifyClient.aiSearch()\\n6. DifyClient.techPackage()\\n7. DifyClient.techStrategy()\\n8. DifyClient.techArticle()\\n9. DifyClient.coreDraft()\\n10. DifyClient.techPublish()\\n11. DifyClient.callApp()\\n12. DifyClient.runWorkflow()\\n13. TriggerAgentUseCase.execute()\\n14. ToolExecutor.executeTool() (agent类型)\\n15. SendMessageUseCase.execute()\\n\\n### 前端调用节点（共10个）\\n1. workflowAPI.aiSearch()\\n2. workflowAPI.smartSearch()\\n3. workflowAPI.techPackage()\\n4. workflowAPI.techStrategy()\\n5. workflowAPI.techArticle()\\n6. workflowAPI.coreDraft()\\n7. aiRoleService.chatWithRole()\\n8. aiSearchService.triggerFeatureAgent()\\n9. WorkflowEngine.callAgent()\\n10. 各节点组件的AI调用方法\\n\\n### 页面/组件调用节点（共8个）\\n1. BaseAISearchPage.handleTriggerFeature()\\n2. AIChatPage.handleSendMessage()\\n3. ProjectResourcesPage.handleAISendMessage()\\n4. AiSearchComponent.handleAiSearch()\\n5. AiSearchNode的AI调用\\n6. TechPackageNode的AI调用\\n7. CoreDraftNode的AI调用\\n8. PromotionStrategyNode的AI调用\\n\\n### API路由调用节点（共4个）\\n1. POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat\\n2. POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\\n3. POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents\\n4. POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\n\\n## 八、关键特性\\n\\n1. **多Provider支持**: 支持Dify和Direct Agent两种类型\\n2. **多轮对话**: 支持conversationId传递，实现多轮对话\\n3. **工具调用**: 支持Function Calling，包括嵌套Agent调用\\n4. **工作流编排**: 支持复杂的工作流编排，Agent节点可嵌入工作流\\n5. **上下文管理**: 支持多种上下文管理策略（窗口、摘要等）\\n6. **字段映射**: 支持输入输出字段映射配置\\n7. **超时控制**: 支持执行超时控制\\n8. **错误重试**: 支持错误重试机制\\n\\n## 九、总结\\n\\n本项目共有**37个**主要的AI/Agent调用节点，分布在：\\n- 后端服务层：15个\\n- 前端服务层：10个\\n- 页面/组件层：8个\\n- API路由层：4个\\n\\n这些调用节点形成了一个完整的AI/Agent调用体系，支持多种使用场景和调用方式。\\n\","

= ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt;('用户');\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    \\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = (event?: Event) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到配置更新事件:', event);\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = (event?: Event) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到自定义刷新事件:', event);\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 重新计算 mainItems，activeConfigs:', activeConfigs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        console.log(&amp;amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 找到配置 ${navItem.name}:&amp;amp;#96;, config);\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        console.log(&amp;amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 未找到配置 ${navItem.name}，将显示为禁用状态&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 生成的 mainItems:', items.map(i =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: i.id, label: i.label, disabled: i.disabled })));\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      navigate(path);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt;                   "lineNumber": 45,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"# 项目AI/Agent调用节点完整识别\\n\\n本文档完整识别了todify3项目中所有的AI/Agent调用节点。\\n\\n## 一、后端服务层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. AgentOrchestrator（Agent编排器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 执行Direct Agent类型的AI角色\\n- **调用方法**: &amp;#96;executeAgent(roleId, query, conversationId, context)&amp;#96;\\n- **特点**: \\n  - 支持工具调用（Function Calling）\\n  - 支持多轮对话\\n  - 支持上下文管理\\n  - 支持Prompt变量替换\\n- **使用场景**: Direct Agent类型的AI角色对话\\n\\n### 2. AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&amp;#96; - 直接执行AI角色\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\\n  \\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\\n  \\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&amp;#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\n\\n### 3. DifyClient（Dify客户端）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/DifyClient.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;techPublish(inputs, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 技术发布\\n- **调用节点7**: &amp;#96;callApp(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;#96; - 通用应用调用\\n- **调用节点8**: &amp;#96;runWorkflow(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;#96; - 工作流调用\\n\\n### 4. TriggerAgentUseCase（触发Agent用例）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/TriggerAgent.usecase.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 触发子Agent执行（五看、三定、技术矩阵等）\\n- **调用方式**: \\n  - 通过&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;#96;直接调用AI角色\\n  - 通过&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;调用工作流\\n- **支持的功能类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;five-view-analysis&amp;#96; - 技术转译（五看）\\n  - &amp;#96;three-fix-analysis&amp;#96; - 用户场景挖掘（三定）\\n  - &amp;#96;tech-matrix&amp;#96; - 技术矩阵\\n  - &amp;#96;propagation-strategy&amp;#96; - 传播策略\\n  - &amp;#96;exhibition-video&amp;#96; - 展具与视频\\n  - &amp;#96;translation&amp;#96; - 翻译\\n  - &amp;#96;ppt-outline&amp;#96; - 技术讲稿\\n  - &amp;#96;script&amp;#96; - 脚本\\n\\n### 5. ToolExecutor（工具执行器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;executeTool(toolCall, toolConfig)&amp;#96; - 执行工具调用\\n- **支持的工具类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;search&amp;#96; - 搜索工具\\n  - &amp;#96;calculation&amp;#96; - 计算工具\\n  - &amp;#96;time&amp;#96; - 时间工具\\n  - &amp;#96;api&amp;#96; - API调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;workflow&amp;#96; - 工作流调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96; - Agent调用工具（嵌套Agent调用）\\n\\n## 二、前端服务层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. workflowAPI（工作流API）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/api.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;smartSearch(query, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 智能搜索\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n\\n### 2. aiRoleService（AI角色服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiRoleService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;chatWithRole(roleId, query, inputs)&amp;#96; - 与AI角色对话\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 自动根据角色配置选择调用方式\\n\\n### 3. aiSearchService（AI搜索服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiSearchService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;triggerFeatureAgent(conversationId, payload)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 用于触发子Agent（五看、三定等）\\n  - 支持上下文窗口大小配置\\n\\n### 4. WorkflowEngine（工作流引擎）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/workflowEngine.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;callAgent(agent, input)&amp;#96; - 调用Agent\\n  - 通过&amp;#96;aiRoleService.chatWithRole()&amp;#96;调用\\n  - 用于前端工作流执行\\n\\n## 三、前端页面/组件层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. BaseAISearchPage（基础AI搜索页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/ai-search/BaseAISearchPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleTriggerFeature(featureType)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;aiSearchService.triggerFeatureAgent()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持的功能类型：五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播策略等\\n\\n### 2. AIChatPage（AI聊天页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/AIChatPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleSendMessage()&amp;#96; - 发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持多轮对话\\n\\n### 3. ProjectResourcesPage（项目资源页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleAISendMessage()&amp;#96; - AI问答发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持项目资源上下文\\n\\n### 4. AiSearchComponent（AI搜索组件）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/AiSearchComponent.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleAiSearch()&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 5. 独立节点组件\\n以下节点组件都包含AI调用：\\n\\n#### AiSearchNode（AI搜索节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/AiSearchNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### TechPackageNode（技术包装节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/TechPackageNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.techPackage()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### CoreDraftNode（核心稿件节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/CoreDraftNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.coreDraft()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### PromotionStrategyNode（推广策略节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/PromotionStrategyNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.techStrategy()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### PressReleaseNode（新闻稿节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/PressReleaseNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用相关AI服务\\n\\n#### TechNewsletterNode（技术通讯节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/TechNewsletterNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用相关AI服务\\n\\n## 四、后端API路由层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. AI角色路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/aiRole.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat&amp;#96;\\n  - 根据provider类型调用：\\n    - Direct Agent: &amp;#96;AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent()&amp;#96;\\n    - Dify: &amp;#96;DifyGateway.executeChat()&amp;#96; 或 &amp;#96;DifyGateway.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2. AI搜索路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由1**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages&amp;#96; - 发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;SendMessageUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n  \\n- **路由2**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents&amp;#96; - 触发子Agent\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;TriggerAgentUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3. 工作流路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/agentWorkflow.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由1**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute&amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;\\n  \\n- **路由2**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/roles/:id/execute&amp;#96; - 执行AI角色\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 4. 工作流API路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/workflow/api/workflow.routes.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/workflow/ai-search&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;ExecuteAiSearchUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 五、工作流节点类型\\n\\n### 1. Agent节点（工作流编辑器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/AgentNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **类型**: &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 在工作流中调用AI角色\\n- **执行**: 通过后端&amp;#96;AgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()&amp;#96;执行\\n\\n### 2. 其他工作流节点类型\\n- &amp;#96;input&amp;#96; - 输入节点\\n- &amp;#96;output&amp;#96; - 输出节点\\n- &amp;#96;condition&amp;#96; - 条件判断节点\\n- &amp;#96;assign&amp;#96; - 变量赋值节点\\n- &amp;#96;merge&amp;#96; - 数据合并节点\\n- &amp;#96;transform&amp;#96; - 数据转换节点\\n- &amp;#96;memory&amp;#96; - 文本记忆节点\\n\\n## 六、调用链路总结\\n\\n### 链路1: 前端页面 → 前端服务 → 后端API → 后端服务 → Dify/LLM\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n前端页面组件\\n  ↓\\n前端服务层 (workflowAPI/aiRoleService/aiSearchService)\\n  ↓\\n后端API路由层\\n  ↓\\n后端服务层 (AgentWorkflowService/DifyClient/AgentOrchestrator)\\n  ↓\\nDify Gateway / LLM Provider\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 链路2: 工作流执行 → Agent节点 → AI角色\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n工作流执行\\n  ↓\\nAgent节点\\n  ↓\\nAgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()\\n  ↓\\nAI角色配置 (Dify/Direct Agent)\\n  ↓\\nDify Gateway / AgentOrchestrator\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 链路3: 工具调用 → Agent嵌套调用\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\nLLM工具调用\\n  ↓\\nToolExecutor.executeTool()\\n  ↓\\nAgent工具类型\\n  ↓\\nAgentOrchestrator.executeAgent() (嵌套调用)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 七、AI/Agent调用节点统计\\n\\n### 后端调用节点（共15个）\\n1. AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent()\\n2. AgentWorkflowService.executeRole()\\n3. AgentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()\\n4. AgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()\\n5. DifyClient.aiSearch()\\n6. DifyClient.techPackage()\\n7. DifyClient.techStrategy()\\n8. DifyClient.techArticle()\\n9. DifyClient.coreDraft()\\n10. DifyClient.techPublish()\\n11. DifyClient.callApp()\\n12. DifyClient.runWorkflow()\\n13. TriggerAgentUseCase.execute()\\n14. ToolExecutor.executeTool() (agent类型)\\n15. SendMessageUseCase.execute()\\n\\n### 前端调用节点（共10个）\\n1. workflowAPI.aiSearch()\\n2. workflowAPI.smartSearch()\\n3. workflowAPI.techPackage()\\n4. workflowAPI.techStrategy()\\n5. workflowAPI.techArticle()\\n6. workflowAPI.coreDraft()\\n7. aiRoleService.chatWithRole()\\n8. aiSearchService.triggerFeatureAgent()\\n9. WorkflowEngine.callAgent()\\n10. 各节点组件的AI调用方法\\n\\n### 页面/组件调用节点（共8个）\\n1. BaseAISearchPage.handleTriggerFeature()\\n2. AIChatPage.handleSendMessage()\\n3. ProjectResourcesPage.handleAISendMessage()\\n4. AiSearchComponent.handleAiSearch()\\n5. AiSearchNode的AI调用\\n6. TechPackageNode的AI调用\\n7. CoreDraftNode的AI调用\\n8. PromotionStrategyNode的AI调用\\n\\n### API路由调用节点（共4个）\\n1. POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat\\n2. POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\\n3. POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents\\n4. POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\n\\n## 八、关键特性\\n\\n1. **多Provider支持**: 支持Dify和Direct Agent两种类型\\n2. **多轮对话**: 支持conversationId传递，实现多轮对话\\n3. **工具调用**: 支持Function Calling，包括嵌套Agent调用\\n4. **工作流编排**: 支持复杂的工作流编排，Agent节点可嵌入工作流\\n5. **上下文管理**: 支持多种上下文管理策略（窗口、摘要等）\\n6. **字段映射**: 支持输入输出字段映射配置\\n7. **超时控制**: 支持执行超时控制\\n8. **错误重试**: 支持错误重试机制\\n\\n## 九、总结\\n\\n本项目共有**37个**主要的AI/Agent调用节点，分布在：\\n- 后端服务层：15个\\n- 前端服务层：10个\\n- 页面/组件层：8个\\n- API路由层：4个\\n\\n这些调用节点形成了一个完整的AI/Agent调用体系，支持多种使用场景和调用方式。\\n\","

= ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt;('用户');\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    \\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = (event?: Event) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到配置更新事件:', event);\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = (event?: Event) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到自定义刷新事件:', event);\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 重新计算 mainItems，activeConfigs:', activeConfigs.map(c =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        console.log(&amp;amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 找到配置 ${navItem.name}:&amp;amp;#96;, config);\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        console.log(&amp;amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 未找到配置 ${navItem.name}，将显示为禁用状态&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 生成的 mainItems:', items.map(i =&amp;amp;gt; ({ id: i.id, label: i.label, disabled: i.disabled })));\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      navigate(path);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n\\n  const managementModules = [\\n    {\\n      id: 'roles',\\n      title: 'AI角色管理',\\n      description: '创建和管理AI对话角色，关联Dify工作流配置',\\n      icon: Bot,\\n      color: 'blue',\\n      path: '/ai-roles',\\n      badge: '基础层',\\n      features: [\\n        '创建和配置AI角色',\\n        '关联Dify服务器工作流',\\n        '管理角色启用状态',\\n        '测试Dify连接',\\n      ],\\n    },\\n    {\\n      id: 'workflow',\\n      title: 'Agent工作流',\\n      description: '基于AI角色进行流程编排，创建智能工作流',\\n      icon: Workflow,\\n      color: 'green',\\n      path: '/agent-workflow',\\n      badge: '编排层',\\n      features: [\\n        '可视化工作流设计',\\n        '节点编排和连接',\\n        '工作流执行和测试',\\n        '模板管理',\\n      ],\\n    },\\n    {\\n      id: 'chat',\\n      title: '多窗口对话',\\n      description: '创建AI对话窗口，关联AI角色或Agent工作流',\\n      icon: MessageSquare,\\n      color: 'purple',\\n      path: '/ai-chat-multi',\\n      badge: '应用层',\\n      features: [\\n        '多窗口并发对话',\\n        '工作流模式支持',\\n        '实时对话交互',\\n        '工作流执行监控',\\n      ],\\n    },\\n    {\\n      id: 'public',\\n      title: '公开页面配置',\\n      description: '发布验证OK的AI对话为独立页，供外部用户访问',\\n      icon: ExternalLink,\\n      color: 'orange',\\n      path: '/public-page-configs',\\n      badge: '发布层',\\n      features: [\\n        '创建公开访问页面',\\n        '配置显示模式',\\n        '生成访问链接',\\n        '页面管理',\\n      ],\\n    },\\n  ];\\n\\n  const getColorClasses = (color: string, type: 'bg' | 'text' | 'border' | 'hover' = 'bg') =&amp;gt; {\\n    const colors: Record&amp;lt;string, Record&amp;lt;string, string&amp;gt;&amp;gt; = {\\n      blue: {\\n        bg: 'bg-blue-50',\\n        text: 'text-blue-600',\\n        border: 'border-blue-200',\\n        hover: 'hover:bg-blue-100',\\n      },\\n      green: {\\n        bg: 'bg-green-50',\\n        text: 'text-green-600',\\n        border: 'border-green-200',\\n        hover: 'hover:bg-green-100',\\n      },\\n      purple: {\\n        bg: 'bg-purple-50',\\n        text: 'text-purple-600',\\n        border: 'border-purple-200',\\n        hover: 'hover:bg-purple-100',\\n      },\\n      orange: {\\n        bg: 'bg-orange-50',\\n        text: 'text-orange-600',\\n        border: 'border-orange-200',\\n        hover: 'hover:bg-orange-100',\\n      },\\n    };\\n    return colors[color]?.[type] || colors.blue[type];\\n  };\\n\\n  const getBadgeClasses = (color: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const colors: Record&amp;lt;string, string&amp;gt; = {\\n      blue: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border-blue-300',\\n      green: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 border-green-300',\\n      purple: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 border-purple-300',\\n      orange: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border-orange-300',\\n    };\\n    return colors[color] || colors.blue;\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-50 to-gray-100\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;TopNavigation /&amp;gt;\\n\\n      {/* 页面头部 */}\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 py-12\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"text-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mb-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"p-3 bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-blue-700 rounded-2xl shadow-lg\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Sparkles className=\\\"w-10 h-10 text-white\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900\\\"&amp;gt;AI统一管理平台&amp;lt;/h1&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;p className=\\\"text-xl text-gray-600 max-w-3xl mx-auto\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              四层架构体系：从角色配置到公开发布的完整AI工作流管理\\n            &amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 架构流程图 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"mt-12 flex items-center justify-center gap-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {managementModules.map((module, index) =&amp;gt; (\\n              &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={module.id}&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-2\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"text-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                    &amp;lt;div className={&amp;#96;inline-flex items-center justify-center w-12 h-12 rounded-full ${getColorClasses(module.color, 'bg')} ${getColorClasses(module.color, 'border')} border-2&amp;#96;}&amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;module.icon className={&amp;#96;w-6 h-6 ${getColorClasses(module.color, 'text')}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                    &amp;lt;div className={&amp;#96;mt-2 text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${getBadgeClasses(module.color)}&amp;#96;}&amp;gt;\\n                      {module.badge}\\n                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                {index &amp;lt; managementModules.length - 1 &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-12 border-t-2 border-dashed border-gray-300\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n            ))}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n      {/* 管理模块卡片网格 */}\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 py-12\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {managementModules.map((module) =&amp;gt; {\\n            const Icon = module.icon;\\n            \\n            return (\\n              &amp;lt;div\\n                key={module.id}\\n                className=\\\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-lg border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 group cursor-pointer\\\"\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; navigate(module.path)}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                {/* 卡片头部 */}\\n                &amp;lt;div className={&amp;#96;p-6 ${getColorClasses(module.color, 'bg')} border-b ${getColorClasses(module.color, 'border')}&amp;#96;}&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-start justify-between\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;div className={&amp;#96;p-3 rounded-lg bg-white shadow-md ${getColorClasses(module.color, 'text')}&amp;#96;}&amp;gt;\\n                        &amp;lt;Icon className=\\\"w-8 h-8\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;div&amp;gt;\\n                        &amp;lt;h3 className=\\\"text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 group-hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                          {module.title}\\n                        &amp;lt;/h3&amp;gt;\\n                        &amp;lt;p className=\\\"text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                          {module.description}\\n                        &amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n                {/* 功能特性 */}\\n                &amp;lt;div className=\\\"p-6\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"space-y-3\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                    {module.features.map((feature, idx) =&amp;gt; (\\n                      &amp;lt;div key={idx} className=\\\"flex items-center gap-3\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                        &amp;lt;div className={&amp;#96;w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${getColorClasses(module.color, 'bg')}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                        &amp;lt;span className=\\\"text-sm text-gray-700\\\"&amp;gt;{feature}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                    ))}\\n                  &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n                  {/* 进入按钮 */}\\n                  &amp;lt;button\\n                    onClick={(e) =&amp;gt; {\\n                      e.stopPropagation();\\n                      navigate(module.path);\\n                    }}\\n                    className={&amp;#96;mt-6 w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all ${getColorClasses(module.color, 'bg')} ${getColorClasses(module.color, 'text')} ${getColorClasses(module.color, 'hover')} border ${getColorClasses(module.color, 'border')} hover:shadow-md&amp;#96;}\\n                  &amp;gt;\\n                    进入 {module.title.split(' ')[0]}\\n                  &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            );\\n          })}\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n        {/* 使用流程说明 */}\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"mt-16 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-8 text-white\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-4xl mx-auto\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;h2 className=\\\"text-3xl font-bold mb-6 flex items-center gap-3\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;SettingsIcon className=\\\"w-8 h-8\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n              使用流程\\n            &amp;lt;/h2&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {[\\n                { step: '1', title: '配置角色', desc: '创建AI角色并关联Dify工作流' },\\n                { step: '2', title: '编排工作流', desc: '基于角色设计智能工作流程' },\\n                { step: '3', title: '测试对话', desc: '多窗口测试验证工作流' },\\n                { step: '4', title: '公开发布', desc: '发布为公开页面供用户访问' },\\n              ].map((item) =&amp;gt; (\\n                &amp;lt;div key={item.step} className=\\\"text-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-12 h-12 bg-white bg-opacity-20 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3 text-2xl font-bold\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                    {item.step}\\n                  &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;h3 className=\\\"font-semibold text-lg mb-2\\\"&amp;gt;{item.title}&amp;lt;/h3&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;p className=\\\"text-sm text-blue-100\\\"&amp;gt;{item.desc}&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n              ))}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default AIUnifiedManagementPage;\\n\\n\","
