                  "lineNumber": 6646,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Settings,\\n  User,\\n  ChevronDown,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\n];\\n\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\n  '/ai-roles',\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\n  '/ai-management',\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('用户');\\n  \\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\n      if (username) {\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\n        try {\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\n        } catch {\\n          return username;\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\n    }\\n    // 默认返回\\\"用户\\\"\\n    return '用户';\\n  };\\n  \\n  // 初始化用户名\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    \\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    \\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = (event?: Event) =&amp;gt; {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到配置更新事件:', event);\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = (event?: Event) =&amp;gt; {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到自定义刷新事件:', event);\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 重新计算 mainItems，activeConfigs:', activeConfigs.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 找到配置 ${navItem.name}:&amp;#96;, config);\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 未找到配置 ${navItem.name}，将显示为禁用状态&amp;#96;);\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 生成的 mainItems:', items.map(i =&amp;gt; ({ id: i.id, label: i.label, disabled: i.disabled })));\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\n    } else {\\n      navigate(path);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&amp;gt; \\n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\\n      );\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt;                   "lineNumber": 10187,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Settings,\\n  User,\\n  ChevronDown,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\n];\\n\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\n  '/ai-roles',\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\n  '/ai-management',\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('用户');\\n  \\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\n      if (username) {\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\n        try {\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\n        } catch {\\n          return username;\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\n    }\\n    // 默认返回\\\"用户\\\"\\n    return '用户';\\n  };\\n  \\n  // 初始化用户名\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    \\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    \\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = (event?: Event) =&amp;gt; {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到配置更新事件:', event);\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = (event?: Event) =&amp;gt; {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到自定义刷新事件:', event);\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 重新计算 mainItems，activeConfigs:', activeConfigs.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 找到配置 ${navItem.name}:&amp;#96;, config);\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 未找到配置 ${navItem.name}，将显示为禁用状态&amp;#96;);\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 生成的 mainItems:', items.map(i =&amp;gt; ({ id: i.id, label: i.label, disabled: i.disabled })));\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\n    } else {\\n      navigate(path);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&amp;gt; \\n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\\n      );\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;Route\\\\n            path=\\\\\\\"/public-chat/:token\\\\\\\"\\\\n            element={&amp;amp;lt;PublicChatPage /&amp;amp;gt;}\\\\n                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import { useParams, useNavigate } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport PressReleasePage from \\\\\\\"./PressReleasePage\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport TechPackagePage from \\\\\\\"./TechPackagePage\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport PageTransition from \\\\\\\"../components/PageTransition\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport TopNavigation from \\\\\\\"../components/TopNavigation\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfigPreview } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/aiRole\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\n// 保留的路由路径，不应该被当作地址配置处理\\\\nconst RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\\\n  'workflow', 'config', 'tech-points', 'car-series', 'ai-search-test',\\\\n  'ai-chat', 'workflow-stats', 'enhanced-workflow-stats', 'history',\\\\n  'ai-roles', 'ai-chat-multi', 'agent-workflow', 'public-page-configs',\\\\n  'ai-management', 'public-chat',\\\\n  // 标准独立页面路由\\\\n  'tech-package', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article', 'press-release',\\\\n  // 向后兼容的路由（已重定向）\\\\n  'ai-search', 'tech-publish',\\\\n  // 管理页面路由\\\\n  'template-management', 'field-mapping-management'\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\\\n */\\\",\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport {\\\\n  MessageCircle,\\\\n  Target,\\\\n  FileText,\\\\n  Mic,\\\\n  Home,\\\\n  Settings,\\\\n  User,\\\\n  ChevronDown,\\\\n} from \\\\\\\"lucide-react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  label: string;\\\\n  icon: any;\\\\n  path: string;\\\\n  disabled: boolean;\\\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\\\n  configId?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\\\n  '/ai-roles',\\\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\\\n  '/ai-management',\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt;('用户');\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\\\n      if (username) {\\\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\\\n        try {\\\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n          return username;\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 默认返回\\\\\\\"用户\\\\\\\"\\\\n    return '用户';\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 初始化用户名\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    \\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\\\n    } else {\\\\n      navigate(path);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\\\n    if (path === '/') {\\\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\\\n    }\\\\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\\\\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\\\\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&amp;amp;gt; \\\\n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\\\\n      );\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 精确匹配\\\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return (\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n\\\\n          return (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\\\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\\\n                  ${\\\\n                    item.disabled\\\\n                      ? \\\\\\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                      : isCurrent\\\\n                        ? \\\\\\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"\\\\n                        : \\\\\\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                  }\\\\n                &amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n                title={item.label}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;amp;#96;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                \\\\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                )}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          );\\\\n        })}\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    );\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  return (\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center h-16 justify-between\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          {/* 左侧导航项 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {/* 第一组：项目管理 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            \\\\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n            {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 右侧：加载状态和用户标识 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center gap-4\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\\\n            {loading &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            )}\\\\n\\\\n            {/* 用户标识和下拉菜单 */}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"relative flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; setUserMenuOpen(!userMenuOpen)}\\\\n                className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-200\\\\\\\"\\\\n                title={currentUsername}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;User className=\\\\\\\"w-4 h-4\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{currentUsername}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;ChevronDown className={&amp;amp;#96;w-4 h-4 transition-transform duration-200 ${userMenuOpen ? 'transform rotate-180' : ''}&amp;amp;#96;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n              {/* 下拉菜单 */}\\\\n              {userMenuOpen &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  {/* 背景遮罩，点击关闭菜单 */}\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div\\\\n                    className=\\\\\\\"fixed inset-0 z-40\\\\\\\"\\\\n                    onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; setUserMenuOpen(false)}\\\\n                  /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  {/* 下拉菜单内容 */}\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"absolute right-0 top-full mt-2 w-48 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 py-1 z-50\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                    {managementItems.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n                      const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n                      const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n                      \\\\n                      return (\\\\n                        &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                          key={item.id}\\\\n                          onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n                            handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id);\\\\n                            setUserMenuOpen(false);\\\\n                          }}\\\\n                          disabled={item.disabled}\\\\n                          className={&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n                            w-full flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium\\\\n                            transition-colors duration-200\\\\n                            ${\\\\n                              item.disabled\\\\n                                ? \\\\\\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                                : isCurrent\\\\n                                  ? \\\\\\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                                  : \\\\\\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                            }\\\\n                          &amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n                        &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                          &amp;amp;lt;Icon className=\\\\\\\"w-4 h-4\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                          &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                        &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                      );\\\\n                    })}\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;/&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              )}\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  );\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\\\n\\\",\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import { useParams, useNavigate } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport PressReleasePage from \\\\\\\"./PressReleasePage\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport TechPackagePage from \\\\\\\"./TechPackagePage\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport PageTransition from \\\\\\\"../components/PageTransition\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport TopNavigation from \\\\\\\"../components/TopNavigation\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfigPreview } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/aiRole\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\n// 保留的路由路径，不应该被当作地址配置处理\\\\nconst RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\\\n  'workflow', 'config', 'tech-points', 'car-series', 'ai-search-test',\\\\n  'ai-chat', 'workflow-stats', 'enhanced-workflow-stats', 'history',\\\\n  'ai-roles', 'ai-chat-multi', 'agent-workflow', 'public-page-configs',\\\\n  'ai-management', 'public-chat',\\\\n  // 标准独立页面路由\\\\n  'tech-package', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article', 'press-release',\\\\n  // 向后兼容的路由（已重定向）\\\\n  'ai-search', 'tech-publish',\\\\n  // 管理页面路由\\\\n  'template-management', 'field-mapping-management'\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\\\n */\\\",\""

= ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    navigate(path);\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\\\n    if (path === '/') {\\\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 精确匹配\\\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return (\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n\\\\n          return (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\\\n                  ${\\\\n                    item.disabled\\\\n                      ? \\\\\\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                      : isCurrent\\\\n                        ? \\\\\\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"\\\\n                        : \\\\\\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                  }\\\\n                &amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n                title={item.label}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;amp;#96;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                \\\\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                )}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          );\\\\n        })}\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    );\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  return (\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          \\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;h1 className=\\\\\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;/h1&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          )}\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\\\n          {loading &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"ml-4 flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          )}\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  );\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\\\n\\\",\""

= ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt;([]);\\\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.address\\\\n      );\\\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n\\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\\\n    };\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: 'home',\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\\\n        (c) =&amp;amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    navigate(path);\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\\\n    if (path === '/') {\\\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 精确匹配\\\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return (\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n\\\\n          return (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\\\n                  ${\\\\n                    item.disabled\\\\n                      ? \\\\\\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                      : isCurrent\\\\n                        ? \\\\\\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"\\\\n                        : \\\\\\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                  }\\\\n                &amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n                title={item.label}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;amp;#96;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                \\\\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                )}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          );\\\\n        })}\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    );\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  return (\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          \\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;h1 className=\\\\\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;/h1&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          )}\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\\\n          {loading &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"ml-4 flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          )}\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  );\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\\\n\\\",\""

{\\\\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\\\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\\\\n    path: req.path,\\\\n    params: req.params,\\\\n    query: req.query,\\\\n    body: req.body,\\\\n  });\\\\n  next();\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 注册路由\\\\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/projects', projectsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\\\\n\\\\n// 健康检查\\\\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\\\n    headers: req.headers,\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    url: req.url,\\\\n  });\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const response = {\\\\n      success: true,\\\\n      message: 'API is running',\\\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\\\n    };\\\\n    res.json(response);\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\\\n    res.status(500).json({\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\\\n    });\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 简单测试端点\\\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.debug('Test endpoint called');\\\\n  res.json({\\\\n    success: true,\\\\n    message: 'Test endpoint working',\\\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\\\\n  });\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 404 处理中间件（必须在所有路由之后）\\\\nrouter.use((req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.warn('API 路由未找到', {\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\\\n    path: req.path,\\\\n  });\\\\n  res.status(404).json({\\\\n    success: false,\\\\n    error: {\\\\n      code: 'NOT_FOUND',\\\\n      message: &amp;amp;#96;路由不存在: ${req.method} ${req.path}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n    },\\\\n  });\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\nexport default router;\\\",\""

'A问答模版' :\\n                          formData.templateType === 'ai-chat' ? 'AI问答模版（带附加信息）' :\\n                          formData.templateType === 'ai-chat-edit' ? (\\n                      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"mt-3\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                        &amp;lt;label className=\\\"block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                          自定义HTML内容\\n                        &amp;lt;/label&amp;gt;\\n                        &amp;lt;textarea\\n                          value={formData.customHtml}\\n                          onChange={(e) =&amp;gt;                   "lineNumber": 15369,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\n];\\n\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\n  '/ai-roles',\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\n  '/ai-management',\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle })\\n;\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const PublicPageConfigManagementPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;TopNavigation /&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"container mx-auto px-4 py-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-between mb-6\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900\\\"&amp;gt;公开页面配置管理&amp;lt;/h1&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;p className=\\\"text-gray-600 mt-1\\\"&amp;gt;配置和管理您的公开AI对话页面&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 快速导航 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-2 mt-3\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;a\\n                href=\\\"/ai-roles\\\"\\n                className=\\\"text-sm text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 transition-colors\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                → AI角色管理\\n              &amp;lt;/a&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;|&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;a\\n                href=\\\"/agent-workflow\\\"\\n                className=\\\"text-sm text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 transition-colors\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                → 管理工作流\\n              &amp;lt;/a&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;|&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;a\\n                href=\\\"/ai-chat-multi\\\"\\n                className=\\\"text-sm text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 transition-colors\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                → 多窗口对话\\n              &amp;lt;/a&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-3\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;a\\n              href=\\\"/template-management\\\"\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 15687,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"function App() {\\n\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/enhanced-workflow-stats\\\"\\n            element={&amp;lt;EnhancedWorkflowStatsPage /&amp;gt;}\\n            data-oid=\\\"enhanced-workflow-stats\\\"\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/history\\\"\\n /&amp;gt;}\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/ai-roles\\\"\\n            element={&amp;lt;AIRoleManagementPage /&amp;gt;}\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/ai-chat-multi\\\"\\n            element={&amp;lt;MultiChatContainer /&amp;gt;}\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n  element={&amp;lt;PublicPageConfigManagementPage /&amp;gt;}\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/template-management\\\"\\n            element={&amp;lt;TemplateManagementPage /&amp;gt;}\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/ai-management\\\"\\n            element={&amp;lt;AIUnifiedManagementPage /&amp;gt;}\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/public-chat/:token\\\"\\n            element={&amp;lt;PublicChatPage /&amp;gt;}\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 标准独立页面路由 */}\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/tech-package\\\"\\n            element={&amp;lt;TechPackagePage /&amp;gt;}\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/tech-strategy\\\"\\n            element={&amp;lt;TechStrategyPage /&amp;gt;}\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/tech-article\\\"\\n            element={&amp;lt;TechArticlePage /&amp;gt;}\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/press-release\\\"\\n            element={&amp;lt;PressReleasePage /&amp;gt;}\\n /&amp;gt;}\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/tech-publish\\\"\\n            element={&amp;lt;Navigate to=\\\"/press-release\\\" replace /&amp;gt;}\\n          /&amp;gt;\\n\\n          &amp;lt;Route\\n            path=\\\"/field-mapping-management\\\"\\n}\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 16954,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { useParams, useNavigate } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport PressReleasePage from \\\"./PressReleasePage\\\";\\nimport TechPackagePage from \\\"./TechPackagePage\\\";\\nimport PageTransition from \\\"../components/PageTransition\\\";\\nimport TopNavigation from \\\"../components/TopNavigation\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfigPreview } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from \\\"../types/aiRole\\\";\\n\\n// 保留的路由路径，不应该被当作地址配置处理\\nconst RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\n  'workflow', 'config', 'tech-points', 'car-series', 'ai-search-test',\\n  'ai-chat', 'workflow-stats', 'enhanced-workflow-stats', 'history',\\n  'ai-roles', 'ai-chat-multi', 'agent-workflow', 'public-page-configs',\\n  'ai-management', 'public-chat',\\n  // 标准独立页面路由\\n  'tech-package', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article', 'press-release',\\n  // 向后兼容的路由（已重定向）\\n  'ai-search', 'tech-publish',\\n  // 管理页面路由\\n  'template-management', 'field-mapping-management'\\n];\\n\\n/**\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\n */\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 17009,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"  'ai-roles', 'ai-chat-multi', 'agent-workflow', 'public-page-configs',\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 18360,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Settings,\\n  User,\\n  ChevronDown,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\n];\\n\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\n  '/ai-roles',\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\n  '/ai-management',\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('用户');\\n  \\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\n      if (username) {\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\n        try {\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\n        } catch {\\n          return username;\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\n    }\\n    // 默认返回\\\"用户\\\"\\n    return '用户';\\n  };\\n  \\n  // 初始化用户名\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    \\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    \\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\n    } else {\\n      navigate(path);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&amp;gt; \\n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\\n      );\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      setLoading(true);\\\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\\\n        (config) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 初始加载\\\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\\\n\\\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;amp;gt;
