c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\\\n      );\\\\n\\\\n      if (config) {\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: config.id,\\\\n          label: config.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: &amp;amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          disabled: false,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n          configId: config.id,\\\\n        });\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\\\n        items.push({\\\\n          id: &amp;amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          label: navItem.name,\\\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n          path: navItem.path,\\\\n          disabled: true,\\\\n          category: 'main',\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    return items;\\\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n      id: navItem.path,\\\\n      label: navItem.name,\\\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\\\n      path: navItem.path,\\\\n      disabled: false,\\\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\\\n    }));\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (disabled) {\\\\n      return;\\\\n    }\\\\n    navigate(path);\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\\\n    if (path === '/') {\\\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\\\n    }\\\\n    // 精确匹配\\\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    return (\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\\\n\\\\n          return (\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;button\\\\n                onClick={() =&amp;amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\\\n                className={&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\\\n                  ${\\\\n                    item.disabled\\\\n                      ? \\\\\\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                      : isCurrent\\\\n                        ? \\\\\\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"\\\\n                        : \\\\\\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\\\\\"\\\\n                  }\\\\n                &amp;amp;#96;}\\\\n                title={item.label}\\\\n              &amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;amp;#96;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                \\\\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (\\\\n                  &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\\\\\" /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n                )}\\\\n              &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            &amp;amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          );\\\\n        })}\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    );\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  return (\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n      &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n        &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n          \\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;span className=\\\\\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;｜&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\\\\"flex items-center\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\\\n          &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n\\\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    navigate(path);\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ?                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { useParams, useNavigate } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport PressReleasePage from \\\"./PressReleasePage\\\";\\nimport TechPackagePage from \\\"./TechPackagePage\\\";\\nimport PageTransition from \\\"../components/PageTransition\\\";\\nimport TopNavigation from \\\"../components/TopNavigation\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfigPreview } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from \\\"../types/aiRole\\\";\\n\\n// 保留的路由路径，不应该被当作地址配置处理\\nconst RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\n  'workflow', 'config', 'tech-points', 'car-series', 'ai-search-test',\\n  'ai-chat', 'workflow-stats', 'enhanced-workflow-stats', 'history',\\n  'ai-roles', 'ai-chat-multi', 'agent-workflow', 'public-page-configs',\\n  'ai-management', 'public-chat',\\n  // 标准独立页面路由\\n  'tech-package', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article', 'press-release',\\n  // 向后兼容的路由（已重定向）\\n  'ai-search', 'tech-publish',\\n  // 管理页面路由\\n  'template-management', 'field-mapping-management'\\n];\\n\\n/**\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\n */\","

                  "lineNumber": 11970,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const PublicPageConfigManagementPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;TopNavigation /&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"container mx-auto px-4 py-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-between mb-6\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900\\\"&amp;gt;公开页面配置管理&amp;lt;/h1&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;p className=\\\"text-gray-600 mt-1\\\"&amp;gt;配置和管理您的公开AI对话页面&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 快速导航 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-2 mt-3\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;a\\n                href=\\\"/ai-roles\\\"\\n                className=\\\"text-sm text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 transition-colors\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                → AI角色管理\\n              &amp;lt;/a&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;|&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;a\\n                href=\\\"/agent-workflow\\\"\\n                className=\\\"text-sm text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 transition-colors\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                → 管理工作流\\n              &amp;lt;/a&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;|&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;a\\n                href=\\\"/ai-chat-multi\\\"\\n                className=\\\"text-sm text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 transition-colors\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                → 多窗口对话\\n              &amp;lt;/a&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-3\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;a\\n              href=\\\"/template-management\\\"\\n;\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Bot,\\n  Workflow,\\n  MessageSquare,\\n  Layers,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    navigate(path);\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          \\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\n                &amp;lt;/h1&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n          {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"ml-4 flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\n\","

{\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React from 'react';\\nimport { Bot, Workflow, MessageSquare, ExternalLink, Sparkles, Settings as SettingsIcon } from 'lucide-react';\\nimport TopNavigation from '../components/TopNavigation';\\nimport { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\\n\\n/**\\n * AI统一管理页面\\n * 整合AI角色、工作流、多窗口对话、公开页面四个核心功能的统一入口\\n */\\nconst AIUnifiedManagementPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n\\n  const managementModules = [\\n    {\\n      id: 'roles',\\n      title: 'AI角色管理',\\n      description: '创建和管理AI对话角色，关联Dify工作流配置',\\n      icon: Bot,\\n      color: 'blue',\\n      path: '/ai-roles',\\n      badge: '基础层',\\n      features: [\\n        '创建和配置AI角色',\\n        '关联Dify服务器工作流',\\n        '管理角色启用状态',\\n        '测试Dify连接',\\n      ],\\n    },\\n    {\\n      id: 'workflow',\\n      title: 'Agent工作流',\\n      description: '基于AI角色进行流程编排，创建智能工作流',\\n      icon: Workflow,\\n      color: 'green',\\n      path: '/agent-workflow',\\n      badge: '编排层',\\n      features: [\\n        '可视化工作流设计',\\n        '节点编排和连接',\\n        '工作流执行和测试',\\n        '模板管理',\\n      ],\\n    },\\n    {\\n      id: 'chat',\\n      title: '多窗口对话',\\n      description: '创建AI对话窗口，关联AI角色或Agent工作流',\\n      icon: MessageSquare,\\n      color: 'purple',\\n      path: '/ai-chat-multi',\\n      badge: '应用层',\\n      features: [\\n        '多窗口并发对话',\\n        '工作流模式支持',\\n        '实时对话交互',\\n        '工作流执行监控',\\n      ],\\n    },\\n    {\\n      id: 'public',\\n      title: '公开页面配置',\\n      description: '发布验证OK的AI对话为独立页，供外部用户访问',\\n      icon: ExternalLink,\\n      color: 'orange',\\n      path: '/public-page-configs',\\n      badge: '发布层',\\n      features: [\\n        '创建公开访问页面',\\n        '配置显示模式',\\n        '生成访问链接',\\n        '页面管理',\\n      ],\\n    },\\n  ];\\n\\n  const getColorClasses = (color: string, type: 'bg' | 'text' | 'border' | 'hover' = 'bg') =&amp;gt; {\\n    const colors: Record&amp;lt;string, Record&amp;lt;string, string&amp;gt;&amp;gt; = {\\n      blue: {\\n        bg: 'bg-blue-50',\\n        text: 'text-blue-600',\\n        border: 'border-blue-200',\\n        hover: 'hover:bg-blue-100',\\n      },\\n      green: {\\n        bg: 'bg-green-50',\\n        text: 'text-green-600',\\n        border: 'border-green-200',\\n        hover: 'hover:bg-green-100',\\n      },\\n      purple: {\\n        bg: 'bg-purple-50',\\n        text: 'text-purple-600',\\n        border: 'border-purple-200',\\n        hover: 'hover:bg-purple-100',\\n      },\\n      orange: {\\n        bg: 'bg-orange-50',\\n        text: 'text-orange-600',\\n        border: 'border-orange-200',\\n        hover: 'hover:bg-orange-100',\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Bot,\\n  Workflow,\\n  MessageSquare,\\n  Layers,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\n    } else {\\n      navigate(path);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 第一组：项目管理 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          \\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\n                &amp;lt;/h1&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n          {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"ml-4 flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\n\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Settings,\\n  User,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\n];\\n\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\n  '/ai-roles',\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\n  '/ai-management',\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\n    } else {\\n      navigate(path);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&amp;gt; \\n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\\n      );\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16 justify-between\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 左侧导航项 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 第一组：项目管理 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            \\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\\n            &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\\n            &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 第三组：Agent配置 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 右侧：加载状态和用户标识 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n            {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;div className=\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            )}\\n\\n            {/* 用户标识 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-200\\\"\\n                title=\\\"用户\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;User className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;用户&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\n\","

{\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\n    headers: req.headers,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    url: req.url,\\n  });\\n  try {\\n    const response = {\\n      success: true,\\n      message: 'API is running',\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\n    };\\n    res.json(response);\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 简单测试端点\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Bot,\\n  Workflow,\\n  MessageSquare,\\n  Layers,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    navigate(path);\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n                  &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                )}\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/React.Fragment&amp;gt;\\n          );\\n        })}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          \\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"mx-3 text-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;｜&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  {currentPageTitle}\\n                &amp;lt;/h1&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n\\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\\n          {loading &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"ml-4 flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default TopNavigation;\\n\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { Router } from 'express';\\n\\nimport workflowModuleRouter from '@/modules/workflow/api/workflow.routes';\\nimport aiSearchModuleRouter from '@/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes';\\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\\n\\nimport techCategoriesRouter from './techCategories';\\nimport techPointsRouter from './techPoints';\\nimport brandsRouter from './brands';\\nimport carModelsRouter from './carModels';\\nimport carSeriesRouter from './carSeries';\\nimport knowledgePointsRouter from './knowledgePointRoutes';\\nimport chatRouter from './chat';\\nimport workflowStatsRouter from './workflowStats';\\nimport difyProxyRouter from './dify-proxy';\\nimport aiRoleRouter from './aiRole';\\nimport agentWorkflowRouter from './agentWorkflow';\\nimport workflowExecutionRouter from './workflowExecution';\\nimport workflowTemplateRouter from './workflowTemplate';\\nimport publicPageConfigRouter from './publicPageConfig';\\nimport pageToolConfigRouter from './pageToolConfig';\\nimport sourceInformationRouter from './sourceInformationRoutes';\\n\\nconst router = Router();\\n\\n// 添加路由级别的日志记录\\nrouter.use((req, res, next) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n    params: req.params,\\n    query: req.query,\\n    body: req.body,\\n  });\\n  next();\\n});\\n\\n// 注册路由\\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\\n\\n// 健康检查\\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\n    headers: req.headers,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    url: req.url,\\n  });\\n  try {\\n    const response = {\\n      success: true,\\n      message: 'API is running',\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\n    };\\n    res.json(response);\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 简单测试端点\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('Test endpoint called');\\n  res.json({\\n    success: true,\\n    message: 'Test endpoint working',\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\\n  });\\n});\\n\\n// 404 处理中间件（必须在所有路由之后）\\nrouter.use((req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.warn('API 路由未找到', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n  });\\n  res.status(404).json({\\n    success: false,\\n    error: {\\n      code: 'NOT_FOUND',\\n      message: &amp;#96;路由不存在: ${req.method} ${req.path}&amp;#96;,\\n    },\\n  });\\n});\\n\\nexport default router;\","

        "contents": "const WorkflowCanvas: React.FC&lt;WorkflowCanvasProps&gt; = \n\n  \n  // 同步外部节点和边变化到内部状态\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 检查节点是否真的发生了变化（包括数据变化）\n    // 使用 JSON.stringify 来深度比较节点数据\n    const currentNodesStr = JSON.stringify(nodes.map(n =&gt; ({\n      id: n.id,\n      type: n.type,\n      data: n.data,\n      position: n.position,\n    })));\n    const incomingNodesStr = JSON.stringify(initialNodes.map(n =&gt; ({\n      id: n.id,\n      type: n.type,\n      data: n.data,\n      position: n.position,\n      agentId: n.agentId,\n    })));\n    \n    const nodesChanged = currentNodesStr !== incomingNodesStr;\n    \n    // 只在非内部更新且节点确实变化时同步外部变化\n    if (!isInternalUpdateRef.current &amp;&amp; nodesChanged) {\n      originalNodesRef.current = initialNodes;\n      const newNodes = convertToReactFlowNodes(initialNodes);\n      setNodes(newNodes);\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = false; // 外部更新不需要通知回去\n      \n      // 延迟执行fitView以确保DOM已更新，并确保所有节点都在视口内\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        if (reactFlowInstanceRef.current &amp;&amp; newNodes.length &gt; 0) {\n          reactFlowInstanceRef.current.fitView({ \n            padding: 0.2, \n            duration: 400,\n            includeHiddenNodes: false,\n            minZoom: 0.1,\n            maxZoom: 2\n          });\n        }\n      }, 200);\n    }\n    isInternalUpdateRef.current = false;\n  }, [initialNodes, convertToReactFlowNodes, setNodes, nodes]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 检查边是否真的发生了变化\n    const currentEdgeIds = new Set(edges.map(e =&gt; e.id));\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const AgentWorkflowPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const handleAddNode = (nodeType: WorkflowNodeType = 'agent') =&gt; {\n    if (!currentWorkflow) {\n      // 如果没有当前工作流，先创建一个\n      const newWorkflow: AgentWorkflow = {\n        id: &#96;workflow-${Date.now()}&#96;,\n        name: &#96;新工作流 ${workflows.length + 1}&#96;,\n        description: '',\n        version: '1.0.0',\n        nodes: [],\n        edges: [],\n        createdAt: new Date(),\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n      };\n      setCurrentWorkflow(newWorkflow);\n      \n      // 延迟添加节点，确保工作流已设置\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        handleAddNode(nodeType);\n      }, 0);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // 计算新节点的位置（避免重叠，使用网格布局）\n    const existingNodes = currentWorkflow.nodes || [];\n    const spacing = 250; // 节点间距\n    const startX = 100;\n    const startY = 100;\n    \n    // 计算网格布局\n    const cols = Math.max(3, Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(existingNodes.length + 1)));\n    const row = Math.floor(existingNodes.length / cols);\n    const col = existingNodes.length % cols;\n    \n    // 获取节点类型元数据\n    const nodeTypeMeta = getNodeTypeMetadata(nodeType);\n    \n    // 根据节点类型创建默认节点\n    const newNode: AgentWorkflowNode = {\n      id: &#96;node_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      type: nodeType,\n      position: { \n        x: startX + col * spacing, \n        y: startY + row * spacing \n      },\n      data: {\n        ...nodeTypeMeta.defaultData,\n        label: &#96;${nodeTypeMeta.name} ${existingNodes.length + 1}&#96;,\n      },\n      // agent类型需要agentId\n      ...(nodeType === 'agent' &amp;&amp; { agentId: '' }),\n    };\n\n    const updatedWorkflow = {\n      ...currentWorkflow,\n      nodes: [...currentWorkflow.nodes, newNode],\n    };\n\n    setCurrentWorkflow(updatedWorkflow);\n    setIsDirty(true);\n    \n    // 选中新添加的节点\n    setSelectedNode(newNode);\n  };\n\n  const handleSave = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!currentWorkflow) return;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export const useWorkflowContext = () =&gt; {\n  const [context, setContext] = useState&lt;WorkflowContext&gt;(getStoredContext);\n\n  // 保存上下文到localStorage\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    saveContext(context);\n  }, [context]);\n\n  // 更新节点状态\n  const updateNodeState = useCallback((nodeId: string, updates: Partial&lt;NodeState&gt;) =&gt; {\n    setContext(prev =&gt; {\n      const newContext = {\n        ...prev,\n        nodes: {\n          ...prev.nodes,\n          [nodeId]: {\n            ...prev.nodes[nodeId],\n            nodeId,\n            ...updates,\n            timestamp: new Date()\n          }\n        }\n      };\n\n      // 如果节点完成，更新完成列表\n      if (updates.status === 'completed' &amp;&amp; !prev.completedNodes.includes(nodeId)) {\n        newContext.completedNodes = [...prev.completedNodes, nodeId];\n      }\n\n      // 更新当前节点\n      if (updates.status === 'loading') {\n        newContext.currentNode = nodeId;\n      }\n\n      // 重新计算可用的下一步\n      if (newContext.currentNode) {\n        newContext.availableNextSteps = getNextSteps(\n          newContext.currentNode,\n          newContext.completedNodes\n        );\n      }\n\n      return newContext;\n    });\n  }, []);\n\n  // 设置当前节点\n  const setCurrentNode = useCallback((nodeId: string) =&gt; {\n    setContext(prev =&gt; ({\n      ...prev,\n      currentNode: nodeId,\n      availableNextSteps: getNextSteps(\n        nodeId,\n        prev.completedNodes\n      )\n    }));\n  }, []);\n\n  // 获取节点状态\n  const getNodeState = useCallback((nodeId: string): NodeState =&gt; {\n    return context.nodes[nodeId] || {\n      nodeId,\n      status: 'idle'\n    };\n  }, [context.nodes]);\n\n  // 检查节点是否可以执行\n  const canExecuteNode = useCallback\n;\n;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 节点配置面板组件\n */\nconst NodeConfigPanel: React.FC&lt;NodeConfigPanelProps&gt; = ({\n  node,\n  agents,\n  workflow,\n  onClose,\n  onSave,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState&lt;Partial&lt;AgentWorkflowNode&gt;&gt;({\n    ...node,\n  });\n  const [showAdvanced, setShowAdvanced] = useState(false);\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;({});\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 当节点变化时，重置表单数据\n    if (node) {\n      setFormData({ \n        ...node,\n        // 确保 data 字段被正确初始化\n        data: node.data ? { ...node.data } : {} as any,\n      });\n    }\n  }, [node]);\n\n  const isValid = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    const e: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {};\n    if (!node) return true;\n    if (node.type === 'agent') {\n      if (!formData.agentId || String(formData.agentId).trim() === '') e.agentId = '请选择Agent';\n    }\n    if (node.type === 'input') {\n      const data = formData.data as any;\n      const inputs = (data?.inputs || []) as InputParameter[];\n      const names = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n      inputs.forEach((p, i) =&gt; {\n        const name = (p.name || '').trim();\n        if (!name) e[&#96;input_name_${i}&#96;] = '参数名不能为空';\n        if (name) {\n          if (names.has(name)) e[&#96;input_name_${i}&#96;] = '参数名重复';\n          names.add(name);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n    if (node.type === 'output') {\n      const data = formData.data as any;\n      const outputs = (data?.outputs || []) as OutputParameter[];\n      const names = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n      outputs.forEach((p, i) =&gt; {\n        const name = (p.name || '').trim();\n        if (!name) e[&#96;output_name_${i}&#96;] = '输出名不能为空';\n        if (name) {\n          if (names.has(name)) e[&#96;output_name_${i}&#96;] = '输出名重复';\n          names.add(name);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n    setErrors(e);\n    return Object.keys(e).length === 0;\n  }, [formData, node]);\n\n  const handleSave = () =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.trae/documents/Agent Workflow 页交互优化方案.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 25
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 62
          }
        },
        "contents": "- 替换以下位置的 &#96;alert/confirm&#96;：\n  - 未保存变更切换 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:161&#96;\n  - 删除工作流 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:172&#96;\n  - 发布/取消发布 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:817&#96;\n  - 保存/执行失败提示 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:316&#96;, &#96;571&#96;\n  - 仍要创建智能工作流的确认 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:121&#96;\n\n2) 执行输入对话框重构为 React 组件\n- 用 &#96;FormModal&#96; 管理输入参数表单与校验，移除直接 DOM 操作 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:378&#96;\n- 支持参数类型（string/number/boolean/object/array/file）对应的表单控件与校验\n- 显示校验错误的就地提示（必填、JSON 解析、文件类型/大小）\n- 保留预填默认值与一键预览输入\n\n3) 节点配置即时校验与提示\n- 在 &#96;NodeConfigPanel&#96; 为关键字段加校验状态与错误文案：\n  - Agent 选择必填、输入/输出参数的名称唯一与类型合法\n  - 条件、赋值、转换等节点的字段格式与必填校验\n- 禁用“保存”按钮直至校验通过；错误聚焦便于修正 &#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/NodeConfigPanel.tsx:1290&#96;\n\n4) 工具栏快捷键与可发现性\n- 在 &#96;AgentWorkflowPage&#96; 顶层注册快捷键：\n  - 保存 &#96;Cmd/Ctrl + S&#96;\n  - 运行 &#96;Cmd/Ctrl + Enter&#96;\n  - 添加节点菜单 &#96;A&#96;\n  - 重命名当前工作流 &#96;F2&#96;\n  - 切换侧边栏显示 &#96;Cmd/Ctrl + B&#96;\n- 在 &#96;ToolbarPanel&#96; 的按钮 &#96;title&#96; 中展示快捷键提示 &#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/ToolbarPanel.tsx&#96;\n\n5) 画布交互增强\n- 吸附到网格与智能对齐线，减少节点摆放成本\n- 连接引导（高亮可连接目标、禁止自连接即时提示）\n- 框选与批量移动/删除，提升复杂场景编辑效率\n- 连接重复检测与就地提醒（现有 &#96;console.warn&#96; 改为 UI 提示） &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:690&#96;\n\n6) 工作流列表与侧边栏体验\n- 重命名交互优化：回车保存、ESC 取消，失败用 toast 提示 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:958&#96;\n- 列表支持搜索过滤与排序（按更新时间/节点数）",
        "signatures": {},

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.trae/documents/Agent Workflow 页交互优化方案.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 27
          }
        },
        "contents": "## 目标\n- 将阻塞式弹窗替换为一致的非阻塞通知与确认，提升操作流畅度\n- 用 React 组件重构输入对话框和确认对话框，消除直接 DOM 操作\n- 增强节点配置的即时校验与可视化提示，减少保存失败与误操作\n- 增加高频操作的键盘快捷键，优化工作流编辑效率\n- 改善画布编辑反馈（吸附、连接引导、批量选择），降低学习成本\n- 优化工作流列表的重命名、搜索与状态持久化，提升管理体验\n\n## 现状与痛点（代码位置）\n- 使用浏览器 &#96;alert/confirm&#96; 造成阻塞与不一致的体验：\n  - 切换/删除/发布等均为同步确认 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:161&#96;, &#96;172&#96;, &#96;817&#96;\n  - 执行失败与保存失败使用 &#96;alert&#96; &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:316&#96;, &#96;571&#96;\n- 执行输入参数对话框通过动态 DOM 拼装，不可复用且难维护：\n  - 直接 &#96;document.createElement&#96; 构建弹层与表单 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:378&#96;\n- 节点配置保存缺少细粒度校验与错误就地提示：\n  - 主要通过 &#96;console&#96; 与 &#96;alert&#96; 反馈 &#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/NodeConfigPanel.tsx:186&#96;\n- 工具栏无键盘快捷键指引，需频繁鼠标操作：\n  - &#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/ToolbarPanel.tsx&#96;\n- 画布反馈有限：无连接引导、无吸附、多选支持弱：\n  - &#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/WorkflowCanvas.tsx&#96;\n\n## 交互改造项\n1) 通知与确认统一组件\n- 引入已在项目中使用的 &#96;sonner&#96; toast（参考 &#96;frontend/src/features/workflow/api/documentMutations.ts:30&#96;）\n- 新增 &#96;ConfirmDialog&#96; 与 &#96;FormModal&#96; 通用组件，统一风格与可访问性（ESC/Enter 支持）\n- 替换以下位置的 &#96;alert/confirm&#96;：\n  - 未保存变更切换 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:161&#96;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.trae/documents/Agent Workflow 页交互优化方案.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 27
          }
        },
        "contents": "## 目标\n- 将阻塞式弹窗替换为一致的非阻塞通知与确认，提升操作流畅度\n- 用 React 组件重构输入对话框和确认对话框，消除直接 DOM 操作\n- 增强节点配置的即时校验与可视化提示，减少保存失败与误操作\n- 增加高频操作的键盘快捷键，优化工作流编辑效率\n- 改善画布编辑反馈（吸附、连接引导、批量选择），降低学习成本\n- 优化工作流列表的重命名、搜索与状态持久化，提升管理体验\n\n## 现状与痛点（代码位置）\n- 使用浏览器 &#96;alert/confirm&#96; 造成阻塞与不一致的体验：\n  - 切换/删除/发布等均为同步确认 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:161&#96;, &#96;172&#96;, &#96;817&#96;\n  - 执行失败与保存失败使用 &#96;alert&#96; &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:316&#96;, &#96;571&#96;\n- 执行输入参数对话框通过动态 DOM 拼装，不可复用且难维护：\n  - 直接 &#96;document.createElement&#96; 构建弹层与表单 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:378&#96;\n- 节点配置保存缺少细粒度校验与错误就地提示：\n  - 主要通过 &#96;console&#96; 与 &#96;alert&#96; 反馈 &#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/NodeConfigPanel.tsx:186&#96;\n- 工具栏无键盘快捷键指引，需频繁鼠标操作：\n  - &#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/ToolbarPanel.tsx&#96;\n- 画布反馈有限：无连接引导、无吸附、多选支持弱：\n  - &#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/WorkflowCanvas.tsx&#96;\n\n## 交互改造项\n1) 通知与确认统一组件\n- 引入已在项目中使用的 &#96;sonner&#96; toast（参考 &#96;frontend/src/features/workflow/api/documentMutations.ts:30&#96;）\n- 新增 &#96;ConfirmDialog&#96; 与 &#96;FormModal&#96; 通用组件，统一风格与可访问性（ESC/Enter 支持）\n- 替换以下位置的 &#96;alert/confirm&#96;：\n  - 未保存变更切换 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:161&#96;",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "const AgentWorkflowPage: React.FC = \n\n            &lt;/button&gt;\n          )}\n\n          &lt;div className=\"workflow-canvas-wrapper\"&gt;\n            {currentWorkflow ? (\n              &lt;WorkflowCanvas\n                nodes={currentWorkflow.nodes}\n                edges={currentWorkflow.edges}\n                onNodesChange={(updatedNodes) =&gt; {\n                  // 只有当节点真正发生变化时才标记为dirty\n                  const nodesChanged = JSON.stringify(updatedNodes) !== JSON.stringify(currentWorkflow.nodes);\n                  if (nodesChanged) {\n                    setCurrentWorkflow({\n                      ...currentWorkflow,\n                      nodes: updatedNodes as AgentWorkflowNode[],\n                    });\n                    setIsDirty(true);\n                  }\n                }}\n                onEdgesChange={(updatedEdges) =&gt; {\n                  // 只有当边真正发生变化时才标记为dirty\n                  const edgesChanged = JSON.stringify(updatedEdges) !== JSON.stringify(currentWorkflow.edges);\n                  if (edgesChanged) {\n                    setCurrentWorkflow({\n                      ...currentWorkflow,\n                      edges: updatedEdges.map(edge =&gt; ({\n                        id: edge.id,\n                        source: edge.source,\n                        target: edge.target,\n                        sourceHandle: edge.sourceHandle || undefined,\n                        targetHandle: edge.targetHandle || undefined,\n                      })) as AgentWorkflowEdge[],\n                    });\n                    setIsDirty(true);\n                  }\n                }}\n                onConnect={handleConnect}\n                onNodeClick={handleNodeClick}\n                onNodeDelete={handleNodeDelete}\n              /&gt;\n            ) : (\n              &lt;div className=\"empty-canvas\"&gt;\n                &lt;FileText size={64} className=\"text-gray-300\" /&gt;\n;",

        "contents": "- 替换以下位置的 &#96;alert/confirm&#96;：\n  - 未保存变更切换 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:161&#96;\n  - 删除工作流 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:172&#96;\n  - 发布/取消发布 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:817&#96;\n  - 保存/执行失败提示 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:316&#96;, &#96;571&#96;\n  - 仍要创建智能工作流的确认 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:121&#96;\n\n2) 执行输入对话框重构为 React 组件\n- 用 &#96;FormModal&#96; 管理输入参数表单与校验，移除直接 DOM 操作 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:378&#96;\n- 支持参数类型（string/number/boolean/object/array/file）对应的表单控件与校验\n- 显示校验错误的就地提示（必填、JSON 解析、文件类型/大小）\n- 保留预填默认值与一键预览输入\n\n3) 节点配置即时校验与提示\n- 在 &#96;NodeConfigPanel&#96; 为关键字段加校验状态与错误文案：\n  - Agent 选择必填、输入/输出参数的名称唯一与类型合法\n  - 条件、赋值、转换等节点的字段格式与必填校验\n- 禁用“保存”按钮直至校验通过；错误聚焦便于修正 &#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/NodeConfigPanel.tsx:1290&#96;\n\n4) 工具栏快捷键与可发现性\n- 在 &#96;AgentWorkflowPage&#96; 顶层注册快捷键：\n  - 保存 &#96;Cmd/Ctrl + S&#96;\n  - 运行 &#96;Cmd/Ctrl + Enter&#96;\n  - 添加节点菜单 &#96;A&#96;\n  - 重命名当前工作流 &#96;F2&#96;\n  - 切换侧边栏显示 &#96;Cmd/Ctrl + B&#96;\n- 在 &#96;ToolbarPanel&#96; 的按钮 &#96;title&#96; 中展示快捷键提示 &#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/ToolbarPanel.tsx&#96;\n\n5) 画布交互增强\n- 吸附到网格与智能对齐线，减少节点摆放成本\n- 连接引导（高亮可连接目标、禁止自连接即时提示）\n- 框选与批量移动/删除，提升复杂场景编辑效率\n- 连接重复检测与就地提醒（现有 &#96;console.warn&#96; 改为 UI 提示） &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:690&#96;\n\n6) 工作流列表与侧边栏体验\n- 重命名交互优化：回车保存、ESC 取消，失败用 toast 提示 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:958&#96;\n- 列表支持搜索过滤与排序（按更新时间/节点数）",

        "contents": "const WorkflowCanvas: React.FC&lt;WorkflowCanvasProps&gt; = \nconst handleNodesChange = \n\n    [onNodesChange]\n  );\n\n  // 处理边变化（仅更新内部状态）\n  const handleEdgesChange = useCallback(\n    (changes: any) =&gt; {\n      isInternalUpdateRef.current = true;\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = true;\n      onEdgesChange(changes);\n    },\n    [onEdgesChange]\n  );\n\n  // 处理连接\n  const handleConnect = useCallback(\n    (connection: Connection) =&gt; {\n      if (readOnly) return;\n      \n      // 验证连接有效性\n      if (!connection.source || !connection.target) {\n        console.warn('连接无效：缺少源节点或目标节点');\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      // 检查是否是自连接\n      if (connection.source === connection.target) {\n        console.warn('不能连接节点到自身');\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      const newEdge: AgentWorkflowEdge = {\n        id: &#96;edge-${connection.source}-${connection.target}-${Date.now()}&#96;,\n        source: connection.source || '',\n        target: connection.target || '',\n        sourceHandle: connection.sourceHandle || undefined,\n        targetHandle: connection.targetHandle || undefined,\n      };\n      \n      const newEdges = addEdge(connection, edges);\n      setEdges(newEdges);\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = true;\n      \n      console.log('添加连接:', newEdge);\n      \n      // 通知外部\n      if (externalOnConnect) {\n        externalOnConnect(connection);\n      }\n    },\n    [readOnly, edges, setEdges, externalOnConnect]\n  );\n\n  // 处理节点点击\n  const handleNodeClick = useCallback(\n    (_event: React.MouseEvent, node: Node) =&gt; {\n      if (onNodeClick) {\n        onNodeClick(node);\n      }\n    },\n    [onNodeClick]\n  );\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"workflow-canvas\"&gt;\n;",
