        "contents": "/**\n * 工作流画布组件\n */\nconst WorkflowCanvas: React.FC&lt;WorkflowCanvasProps&gt; = ({\n  nodes: initialNodes,\n  edges: initialEdges,\n  onNodesChange: externalNodesChange,\n  onEdgesChange: externalEdgesChange,\n  onConnect: externalOnConnect,\n  onNodeClick,\n  onNodeDelete,\n  readOnly = false,\n}) =&gt; {\n  // 转换内部节点格式为ReactFlow格式\n  const convertToReactFlowNodes = useCallback((nodes: AgentWorkflowNode[]): Node[] =&gt; {\n    return nodes.map((node) =&gt; {\n      // 确保节点位置有效，如果无效或为负数则设置为默认值\n      const defaultX = 100;\n      const defaultY = 100;\n      \n      let positionX = defaultX;\n      let positionY = defaultY;\n      \n      if (node.position) {\n        // 验证x坐标\n        if (typeof node.position.x === 'number' &amp;&amp; !isNaN(node.position.x) &amp;&amp; node.position.x &gt;= 0) {\n          positionX = node.position.x;\n        }\n        // 验证y坐标\n        if (typeof node.position.y === 'number' &amp;&amp; !isNaN(node.position.y) &amp;&amp; node.position.y &gt;= 0) {\n          positionY = node.position.y;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      const position = {\n        x: positionX,\n        y: positionY,\n      };\n      \n      return {\n        id: node.id,\n        type: node.type || 'agent',\n        position,\n        data: {\n          ...node.data,\n          agentId: node.agentId, // 确保 agentId 传递到节点数据\n          agentName: (node.data as any).agentName,\n          // 只有非agent类型的节点才传递onDelete\n          ...(node.type !== 'agent' &amp;&amp; { onDelete: () =&gt; onNodeDelete?.(node.id) }),\n        },\n      };\n    });\n  }, [onNodeDelete]);\n\n  // 转换内部边格式为ReactFlow格式\n;",

        "contents": "6) 工作流列表与侧边栏体验\n- 重命名交互优化：回车保存、ESC 取消，失败用 toast 提示 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:958&#96;\n- 列表支持搜索过滤与排序（按更新时间/节点数）\n- 侧边栏折叠状态与选中工作流持久化到 &#96;localStorage&#96;\n\n7) 自动保存与离线容错\n- 当后端不可用（已在服务层识别 &#96;ERR_NETWORK&#96;）时，将工作流草稿保存到 &#96;localStorage&#96;，并在恢复后提示同步\n- 在标题区显示“已保存/上次保存时间”，保存成功与失败用 toast 提示\n\n8) 发布与模板相关交互\n- 发布/取消发布使用 &#96;ConfirmDialog&#96;，并在列表项加“已发布”徽标（已部分存在）\n- 模板保存成功用 toast，失败用错误说明 &#96;frontend/src/pages/AgentWorkflowPage.tsx:1123&#96;\n\n## 实施步骤\n- 第 1 阶段：搭建 &#96;ConfirmDialog&#96;/&#96;FormModal&#96; 与 toast 替换（范围最广，收益最高）\n- 第 2 阶段：重构执行输入对话框为 React（去除直接 DOM）\n- 第 3 阶段：节点配置校验与错误就地提示\n- 第 4 阶段：快捷键接入与按钮提示\n- 第 5 阶段：画布交互（吸附/引导/多选）\n- 第 6 阶段：工作流列表搜索与状态持久化\n- 第 7 阶段：自动保存与离线容错\n\n## 验证与回归\n- 用真实流程（创建→编辑→保存→执行→发布）走查主要路径\n- 后端关闭情况下的离线草稿保存与恢复核验\n- 画布复杂连接与批量编辑的交互一致性验证\n- 无障碍检查（键盘可达、焦点管理、ARIA 标签）\n\n## 交付物\n- 通用交互组件（确认/表单/Toast 集成）与替换落地\n- 页面与画布交互优化代码及单元/行为测试用例\n- 变更说明与快捷键速查（嵌入 UI 的 &#96;title&#96; 文案）",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/docs/ui-ux-design.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 62
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 91
          }
        },
        "contents": "*   **加载状态**: 在调用 Dify API 时，显示一个优雅的、与品牌相关的加载动画（例如，一个跳动的文字光标或流动的脑图），并附上友好的提示语，如“AI 正在为您创作，请稍候...”。\n*   **微交互**: 为按钮点击、悬停、输入框聚焦等提供细微的动效反馈，提升整体体验的精致感。\n\n\n本文档旨在为 Todify3 的核心用户工作流程设计一个直观、高效且用户友好的界面。\n\n## 1. 设计原则\n\n- **线性引导**：用户工作流程是线性的，界面应清晰地引导用户从一步到下一步。\n- **状态明确**：在任何时候，用户都应该清楚自己处于哪个步骤，以及当前步骤的状态（例如，等待输入、正在生成、已完成）。\n- **即时反馈**：对于耗时操作（如 API 调用），应提供明确的加载或进度指示。\n- **灵活编辑**：所有 AI 生成的内容都应是可编辑的，用户拥有最终的控制权。\n- **一致性**：所有步骤的布局和交互应保持一致，降低用户的学习成本。\n\n## 2. 总体布局\n\n我们将采用一个**多步骤的向导式（Wizard）布局**。\n\n- **左侧**：一个垂直的步骤导航器，显示所有工作流步骤（技术概念搜索、技术包装、推广策略等）。当前步骤会被高亮显示，已完成的步骤会有标记。\n- **右侧**：主要内容区，根据当前步骤动态显示不同的内容。\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n+--------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+\n|                                |                                                  |\n|  **工作流程**                  |  &lt;当前步骤标题&gt;                                  |\n|                                |                                                  |\n|  1. 技术概念搜索 (完成)        |  +----------------------------------------------+  |\n|  2. 技术包装 (当前)            |  |                                              |  |\n|  3. 推广策略                   |  |  输入区域 (上一阶段的输出或新输入)           |  |",
        "signatures": {},

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/docs/ui-ux-design.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 36
          }
        },
        "contents": "# 用户工作流程页面 - UI/UX 设计规划\n\n## 1. 设计理念与原则\n\n*   **简洁至上 (Simplicity First)**: 界面应干净、整洁，消除所有不必要的视觉元素，让用户能够专注于内容创作的核心任务。\n*   **流程引导 (Guided Workflow)**: 设计一个清晰、线性的步骤条，让用户时刻了解自己在哪一步，以及接下来要做什么，创造一种掌控感。\n*   **即时反馈 (Instant Feedback)**: 对于用户的每一个操作，系统都应提供即时的视觉反馈。在等待 AI 生成内容时，使用优雅的加载动画和进度说明，缓解用户的等待焦虑。\n*   **一致性 (Consistency)**: 整个应用的色彩、字体、图标和布局风格应保持高度一致，以建立专业、可靠的品牌形象。\n\n## 2. 页面布局与核心组件\n\n### 2.1 总体布局\n\n采用经典的“左侧导航 + 右侧内容区”布局。\n\n*   **左侧导航区**: 固定一个垂直的步骤条（Stepper），清晰地展示五个核心步骤：\n    1.  **智能搜索 (Search)**\n    2.  **技术包装 (Package)**\n    3.  **推广策略 (Promote)**\n    4.  **核心稿 (Draft)**\n    5.  **演讲稿 (Speech)**\n    *   当前步骤高亮显示，已完成的步骤显示为“完成”状态，未开始的步骤置灰。\n*   **右侧内容区**: 这是用户主要的工作区域，根据当前步骤动态显示不同的内容和交互元素。\n\n### 2.2 核心组件设计\n\n#### **步骤一：智能搜索 (Search)**\n\n*   **输入框**: 一个突出、居中的搜索框，带有清晰的占位符文本，如“输入您想探索的技术关键词...”。\n*   **搜索按钮**: 样式与品牌主色调一致，悬停时有动效。\n*   **结果展示**: 以卡片列表的形式展示搜索结果。每张卡片包含标题、摘要和来源链接。设计应简洁，易于快速浏览。\n\n#### **步骤二：技术包装 (Package)**\n\n*   **编辑器**: 引入一个富文本编辑器（如 TipTap 或 TinyMCE），用于展示和编辑生成的文章初稿。\n*   **配置选项**: 在编辑器上方提供一组简单的配置选项，如“文章风格”（入门/进阶）、“目标读者”等，以按钮组或下拉菜单的形式呈现。",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

{\n    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) =&gt; {\n      if (isDragging) {\n        setPosition({\n          x: e.clientX - dragStart.x,\n          y: e.clientY - dragStart.y\n        });\n      }\n      if (isResizing) {\n        const newWidth = Math.max(400, e.clientX - resizeStart.x);\n        const newHeight = Math.max(300, e.clientY - resizeStart.y);\n        setSize({ width: newWidth, height: newHeight });\n      }\n    };\n\n    const handleMouseUp = () =&gt; {\n      setIsDragging(false);\n      setIsResizing(false);\n    };\n\n    if (isDragging || isResizing) {\n      document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);\n      document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);\n    }\n\n    return () =&gt; {\n      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);\n      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);\n    };\n  }, [isDragging, isResizing, dragStart, resizeStart]);\n\n  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) =&gt; {\n    if (windowRef.current) {\n      const rect = windowRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();\n      setDragStart({\n        x: e.clientX - rect.left,\n        y: e.clientY - rect.top\n      });\n      setIsDragging(true);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleResizeMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    setResizeStart({\n      x: size.width,\n      y: size.height\n    });\n    setIsResizing(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleMinimize = () =&gt; {\n    setIsMinimized(!isMinimized);\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "const AgentWorkflowPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const handleAddNode = (nodeType: WorkflowNodeType = 'agent') =&gt; {\n    if (!currentWorkflow) {\n      // 如果没有当前工作流，先创建一个\n      const newWorkflow: AgentWorkflow = {\n        id: &#96;workflow-${Date.now()}&#96;,\n        name: &#96;新工作流 ${workflows.length + 1}&#96;,\n        description: '',\n        version: '1.0.0',\n        nodes: [],\n        edges: [],\n        createdAt: new Date(),\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n      };\n      setCurrentWorkflow(newWorkflow);\n      \n      // 延迟添加节点，确保工作流已设置\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        handleAddNode(nodeType);\n      }, 0);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // 计算新节点的位置（避免重叠，使用网格布局）\n    const existingNodes = currentWorkflow.nodes || [];\n    const spacing = 250; // 节点间距\n    const startX = 100;\n    const startY = 100;\n    \n    // 计算网格布局\n    const cols = Math.max(3, Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(existingNodes.length + 1)));\n    const row = Math.floor(existingNodes.length / cols);\n    const col = existingNodes.length % cols;\n    \n    // 获取节点类型元数据\n    const nodeTypeMeta = getNodeTypeMetadata(nodeType);\n    \n    // 根据节点类型创建默认节点\n    const newNode: AgentWorkflowNode = {\n      id: &#96;node_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      type: nodeType,\n      position: { \n        x: startX + col * spacing, \n        y: startY + row * spacing \n      },\n      data: {\n        ...nodeTypeMeta.defaultData,\n        label: &#96;${nodeTypeMeta.name} ${existingNodes.length + 1}&#96;,\n      },\n      // agent类型需要agentId\n      ...(nodeType === 'agent' &amp;&amp; { agentId: '' }),\n    };\n\n    const updatedWorkflow = {\n      ...currentWorkflow,\n      nodes: [...currentWorkflow.nodes, newNode],\n    };\n\n    setCurrentWorkflow(updatedWorkflow);\n    setIsDirty(true);\n    \n    // 选中新添加的节点\n    setSelectedNode(newNode);\n  };\n\n  const handleSave = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!currentWorkflow) return;\n;\n;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/docs/ui-ux-design.md",
        "range": {

        },
        "contents": "- **输出区**：一个富文本编辑器，显示 AI 生成的技术包装内容。用户可以自由编辑。\n- **按钮组**：\n    - &#96;保存&#96;: 将当前内容保存到数据库。\n    - &#96;导出PDF&#96;: 将编辑器中的内容导出为 PDF 文件。\n    - &#96;下一步&#96;: 进入“推广策略”步骤，并将当前编辑器的内容作为输入。\n\n### 步骤 3: 推广策略\n\n- **输入区**：默认填充上一步的技术包装内容。\n- **操作**：点击“生成推广策略”按钮。\n- **输出区**：富文本编辑器，显示 AI 生成的推广策略。\n- **按钮组**：同上。\n\n### 步骤 4: 技术核心稿\n\n- **输入区**：默认填充上一步的推广策略内容。\n- **操作**：点击“生成技术核心稿”按钮。\n- **输出区**：富文本编辑器，显示 AI 生成的技术核心稿。\n- **按钮组**：同上。\n\n### 步骤 5: 演讲稿撰写\n\n这是一个特殊的步骤，因为它可能需要合并多个核心稿。\n\n- **输入区**：\n    - 一个“选择技术核心稿”的按钮，点击后会弹出一个列表，显示所有已保存的技术核心稿，用户可以多选。\n    - 一个文本区，显示已选核心稿的标题或摘要。\n- **操作**：点击“生成演讲稿”按钮。\n- **输出区**：富文本编辑器，显示 AI 生成的演讲稿。\n- **按钮组**：\n    - &#96;保存&#96;: 保存演讲稿。\n    - &#96;导出PDF&#96;: 导出演讲稿。\n    - &#96;完成&#96;: 结束当前工作流程。\n\n## 4. 技术实现要点\n\n- **前端路由**：使用 React Router 来管理不同步骤的视图。\n- **状态管理**：使用 Zustand 或 React Context 来管理整个工作流的状态，包括每一步的输入和输出数据。\n- **富文本编辑器**：集成一个轻量级的富文本编辑器库，如 TipTap 或 TinyMCE。\n- **PDF导出**：使用 &#96;jspdf&#96; 和 &#96;html2canvas&#96; 等库来实现前端导出 PDF 的功能。\n\n这份设计文档为我们接下来的前端开发工作提供了清晰的蓝图。",

        "contents": "export interface WorkflowState {\n  currentStep: number;\n  stepData: StepData;\n  loading: boolean;\n  loadingText: string;\n  loadingProgress?: number;\n  currentDocument: WorkflowDocument | null;\n  difyConfigs: DifyAPIConfig[];\n  workflowConfigs: WorkflowStepConfig[];\n  configsLoaded: boolean;\n  chatMessages: ChatMessage[];\n  inputMessage: string;\n  isTyping: boolean;\n  editorContent: string;\n  editingStates: Record&lt;number, boolean&gt;;\n  autoSaveTimer: ReturnType&lt;typeof setTimeout&gt; | null;\n  isProcessing: boolean;\n  processError: string | null;\n  isFullscreenEditor: boolean;\n  conversationId: string;\n  smartWorkflow: AgentWorkflow | null;\n  workflowAgents: AIRoleConfig[];\n  useAgentWorkflow: boolean;\n  steps: WorkflowStep[];\n}\n\nexport interface WorkflowActions {\n  setCurrentStep: (step: number) =&gt; void;\n;\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

// 外部更新不需要通知回去\n    }\n    isInternalUpdateRef.current = false;\n  }, [initialEdges, convertToReactFlowEdges, setEdges, edges]);\n\n  // 监听内部节点状态变化并同步到外部（仅当是用户操作时）\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (shouldNotifyRef.current &amp;&amp; externalNodesChange) {\n      const updatedNodes = convertFromReactFlowNodes(nodes, originalNodesRef.current);\n      externalNodesChange(updatedNodes);\n      // 更新ref以保持同步\n      originalNodesRef.current = updatedNodes;\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = false;\n    }\n  }, [nodes, externalNodesChange, convertFromReactFlowNodes]);\n\n  // 监听内部边状态变化并同步到外部（仅当是用户操作时）\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (shouldNotifyRef.current &amp;&amp; externalEdgesChange) {\n      const updatedEdges = convertFromReactFlowEdges(edges);\n      externalEdgesChange(updatedEdges);\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = false;\n    }\n  }, [edges, externalEdgesChange, convertFromReactFlowEdges]);\n\n  // 处理节点变化（仅更新内部状态）\n  const handleNodesChange = useCallback(\n    (changes: any) =&gt; {\n      isInternalUpdateRef.current = true;\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = true;\n      onNodesChange(changes);\n    },\n    [onNodesChange]\n  );\n\n  // 处理边变化（仅更新内部状态）\n  const handleEdgesChange = useCallback(\n    (changes: any) =&gt; {\n      isInternalUpdateRef.current = true;\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = true;\n      onEdgesChange(changes);\n    },\n    [onEdgesChange]\n  );\n\n  // 处理连接\n  const handleConnect = useCallback(\n    (connection: Connection) =&gt; {\n      if (readOnly) return;\n      \n      // 验证连接有效性\n      if (!connection.source || !connection.target) {\n        console.warn('连接无效：缺少源节点或目标节点');\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      // 检查是否是自连接\n      if (connection.source === connection.target) {\n        console.warn('不能连接节点到自身');\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      const newEdge: AgentWorkflowEdge = {\n        id: &#96;edge-${connection.source}-${connection.target}-${Date.now()}&#96;,\n        source: connection.source || '',\n        target: connection.target || '',\n        sourceHandle: connection.sourceHandle || undefined,\n        targetHandle: connection.targetHandle || undefined,\n      };\n      \n      const newEdges = addEdge(connection, edges);\n      setEdges(newEdges);\n      shouldNotifyRef.current = true;\n      \n      console.log('添加连接:', newEdge);\n      \n      // 通知外部\n      if (externalOnConnect) {\n        externalOnConnect(connection);\n      }\n    },\n    [readOnly, edges, setEdges, externalOnConnect]\n  );\n\n  // 处理节点点击\n  const handleNodeClick = useCallback(\n    (_event: React.MouseEvent, node: Node) =&gt; {\n      if (onNodeClick) {\n        onNodeClick(node);\n      }\n    },\n    [onNodeClick]\n  );\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"workflow-canvas\"&gt;\n      &lt;ReactFlow\n        nodes={nodes}\n        edges={edges}\n        onNodesChange={handleNodesChange}\n        onEdgesChange={handleEdgesChange}\n        onConnect={handleConnect}\n        onNodeClick={handleNodeClick}\n        onInit={onInit}\n        nodeTypes={nodeTypes}\n        fitView\n        fitViewOptions={{ padding: 0.2 }}\n        className=\"workflow-canvas-reactflow\"\n        defaultViewport={{ x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 }}\n        defaultEdgeOptions={{\n          type: 'smoothstep',\n          animated: false,\n        }}\n        snapToGrid\n        snapGrid={[20, 20]}\n        selectionOnDrag\n      &gt;\n        &lt;Background variant={BackgroundVariant.Dots} gap={20} size={1} /&gt;\n        &lt;Controls /&gt;\n        &lt;MiniMap /&gt;\n      &lt;/ReactFlow&gt;\n      \n      &lt;style&gt;{&#96;\n        .workflow-canvas {\n          width: 100%;\n          height: 100%;\n          background: #f9fafb;\n        }\n        \n        .workflow-canvas-reactflow {\n          width: 100%;\n          height: 100%;\n        }\n      &#96;}&lt;/style&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n};\n\nexport default WorkflowCanvas;\n\n",

          }
        },
        "contents": "/**\n * 输入源选择器组件\n * 支持选择上游节点的输出作为当前节点的输入\n */\nconst InputSourceSelector: React.FC&lt;InputSourceSelectorProps&gt; = ({\n  currentNodeId,\n  nodes,\n  edges,\n  inputSources = {},\n  onChange,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [expandedNodes, setExpandedNodes] = useState&lt;Set&lt;string&gt;&gt;(new Set());\n  const [showPreview, setShowPreview] = useState(false);\n\n  // 查找所有上游节点（通过边连接关系）\n  const upstreamNodes = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    const upstreamNodeIds = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n    \n    // 通过边的连接关系找到所有直接连接到当前节点的上游节点\n    edges.forEach(edge =&gt; {\n      if (edge.target === currentNodeId) {\n        upstreamNodeIds.add(edge.source);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // 递归查找间接上游节点（处理多层级连接）\n    let hasChanges = true;\n    const maxDepth = 10; // 防止无限循环\n    let depth = 0;\n    \n    while (hasChanges &amp;&amp; depth &lt; maxDepth) {\n      hasChanges = false;\n      depth++;\n      \n      nodes.forEach(node =&gt; {\n        if (!upstreamNodeIds.has(node.id) &amp;&amp; node.id !== currentNodeId) {\n          // 检查是否有边连接到已找到的上游节点\n          const isConnected = edges.some(edge =&gt; {\n            const isSource = edge.source === node.id;\n            const isTarget = upstreamNodeIds.has(edge.target);\n            return isSource &amp;&amp; isTarget;\n          });\n          \n          if (isConnected) {\n            upstreamNodeIds.add(node.id);\n            hasChanges = true;\n          }\n        }\n      });\n    }\n    \n    return nodes.filter(node =&gt; upstreamNodeIds.has(node.id));\n  }, [nodes, edges, currentNodeId]);\n\n  // 切换节点展开/收起状态\n  const toggleNode = (nodeId: string) =&gt; {\n    const newExpanded = new Set(expandedNodes);\n    if (newExpanded.has(nodeId)) {\n      newExpanded.delete(nodeId);\n    } else {\n      newExpanded.add(nodeId);\n    }\n    setExpandedNodes(newExpanded);\n  };\n\n  // 获取节点的输出字段列表（使用标准化的字段定义）\n  const getNodeOutputs = (node: AgentWorkflowNode)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const AgentWorkflowPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const handleNodeSave = (node: AgentWorkflowNode) =&gt; {\n    if (!currentWorkflow) {\n      console.error('无法保存节点：当前工作流不存在');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    console.log('handleNodeSave 被调用:', {\n      nodeId: node.id,\n      nodeType: node.type,\n      nodeData: node.data,\n    });\n\n    // 查找并更新节点\n    const nodeIndex = currentWorkflow.nodes.findIndex(n =&gt; n.id === node.id);\n    \n    if (nodeIndex === -1) {\n      console.error(&#96;无法找到节点 ${node.id}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // 创建新的节点数组，确保深拷贝\n    const updatedNodes = currentWorkflow.nodes.map((n, index) =&gt; {\n      if (index === nodeIndex) {\n        // 确保返回的节点包含所有必要字段\n        return {\n          ...n,\n          ...node,\n          data: {\n            ...n.data,\n            ...node.data,\n          },\n        };\n      }\n      return n;\n    });\n\n    const updatedWorkflow: AgentWorkflow = {\n      ...currentWorkflow,\n      nodes: updatedNodes,\n    };\n\n    console.log('更新工作流:', {\n      workflowId: updatedWorkflow.id,\n      nodesCount: updatedNodes.length,\n      updatedNodeIndex: nodeIndex,\n      updatedNode: updatedNodes[nodeIndex],\n    });\n\n    setCurrentWorkflow(updatedWorkflow);\n    // 更新选中的节点，确保配置面板显示最新数据\n    setSelectedNode(updatedNodes[nodeIndex]);\n    setIsDirty(true);\n    \n    // 提示保存成功\n    console.log('节点配置已保存:', node);\n    \n    // 可以添加用户可见的成功提示\n    // alert('节点配置已保存');\n  };\n\n  const handleConnect = useCallback((connection: Connection) =&gt; {\n    if (!currentWorkflow) return;\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "const AgentWorkflowPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 切换工作流\n  const handleSwitchWorkflow = (workflow: AgentWorkflow, skipCheck?: boolean) =&gt; {\n    // 如果正在编辑名称，不允许切换\n    if (editingWorkflowId) {\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    if (!skipCheck &amp;&amp; isDirty &amp;&amp; currentWorkflow) {\n      setPendingSwitchWorkflow(workflow);\n      setConfirmSwitchOpen(true);\n      return;\n    }\n    setCurrentWorkflow(workflow);\n    setSelectedNode(null);\n    setIsDirty(false);\n  };\n\n  // 删除工作流\n  const handleDeleteWorkflow = async (workflowId: string) =&gt; {\n    setConfirmDeleteId(workflowId);\n  };\n\n  // 创建新工作流\n  const handleCreateNewWorkflow = () =&gt; {\n    if (isDirty &amp;&amp; currentWorkflow) {\n      setConfirmCreateNewOpen(true);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const newWorkflow: AgentWorkflow = {\n      id: &#96;workflow-${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      name: &#96;新工作流 ${workflows.length + 1}&#96;,\n      description: '',\n      version: '1.0.0',\n      nodes: [],\n      edges: [],\n      createdAt: new Date(),\n      updatedAt: new Date(),\n    };\n\n    setCurrentWorkflow(newWorkflow);\n    setSelectedNode(null);\n    setIsDirty(false); // 新创建的工作流初始状态为未修改（因为还没有内容）\n  };\n\n  const loadAgents = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const data = await aiRoleService.getAIRoles();\n      setAgents(data.filter(a =&gt; a.enabled));\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理，不输出错误日志\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        // 静默失败，保持当前状态\n        return;\n      }\n      console.error('加载Agents失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleAddNode = (nodeType: WorkflowNodeType = 'agent') =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const AgentWorkflowPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const handleAddNode = (nodeType: WorkflowNodeType = 'agent') =&gt; {\n    if (!currentWorkflow) {\n      // 如果没有当前工作流，先创建一个\n      const newWorkflow: AgentWorkflow = {\n        id: &#96;workflow-${Date.now()}&#96;,\n        name: &#96;新工作流 ${workflows.length + 1}&#96;,\n        description: '',\n        version: '1.0.0',\n        nodes: [],\n        edges: [],\n        createdAt: new Date(),\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n      };\n      setCurrentWorkflow(newWorkflow);\n      \n      // 延迟添加节点，确保工作流已设置\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        handleAddNode(nodeType);\n      }, 0);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // 计算新节点的位置（避免重叠，使用网格布局）\n    const existingNodes = currentWorkflow.nodes || [];\n    const spacing = 250; // 节点间距\n    const startX = 100;\n    const startY = 100;\n    \n    // 计算网格布局\n    const cols = Math.max(3, Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(existingNodes.length + 1)));\n    const row = Math.floor(existingNodes.length / cols);\n    const col = existingNodes.length % cols;\n    \n    // 获取节点类型元数据\n    const nodeTypeMeta = getNodeTypeMetadata(nodeType);\n    \n    // 根据节点类型创建默认节点\n    const newNode: AgentWorkflowNode = {\n      id: &#96;node_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      type: nodeType,\n      position: { \n        x: startX + col * spacing, \n        y: startY + row * spacing \n      },\n      data: {\n        ...nodeTypeMeta.defaultData,\n        label: &#96;${nodeTypeMeta.name} ${existingNodes.length + 1}&#96;,\n      },\n      // agent类型需要agentId\n      ...(nodeType === 'agent' &amp;&amp; { agentId: '' }),\n    };\n\n    const updatedWorkflow = {\n      ...currentWorkflow,\n      nodes: [...currentWorkflow.nodes, newNode],\n    };\n\n    setCurrentWorkflow(updatedWorkflow);\n    setIsDirty(true);\n    \n    // 选中新添加的节点\n    setSelectedNode(newNode);\n  };\n\n  const handleSave = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!currentWorkflow) return;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 节点字段选择器组件\n * 用于选择上游节点的输出字段，并生成标准化的变量名\n */\nconst NodeFieldSelector: React.FC&lt;NodeFieldSelectorProps&gt; = ({\n  currentNodeId,\n  nodes,\n  value,\n  onChange,\n  showFullVariable = false,\n  placeholder = '选择字段或输入变量名...',\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [expandedNodes, setExpandedNodes] = useState&lt;Set&lt;string&gt;&gt;(new Set());\n  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);\n  const [editValue, setEditValue] = useState(value || '');\n  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);\n\n  // 解析当前值\n  const parsedValue = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    if (!value) return null;\n    return parseNodeFieldVariableName(value);\n  }, [value]);\n\n  // 获取可用节点（排除当前节点）\n  const availableNodes = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    return nodes.filter(node =&gt; node.id !== currentNodeId);\n  }, [nodes, currentNodeId]);\n\n  // 切换节点展开状态\n  const toggleNode = (nodeId: string) =&gt; {\n    const newExpanded = new Set(expandedNodes);\n    if (newExpanded.has(nodeId)) {\n      newExpanded.delete(nodeId);\n    } else {\n      newExpanded.add(nodeId);\n    }\n    setExpandedNodes(newExpanded);\n  };\n\n  // 选择字段\n  const selectField = (nodeId: string, fieldPath: string) =&gt; {\n    const node = nodes.find(n =&gt; n.id === nodeId);\n    if (!node) return;\n    \n    const variableName = generateNodeFieldVariableName(nodeId, node.type, fieldPath);\n    onChange?.(variableName);\n    setIsEditing(false);\n  };\n\n  // 手动输入变量名\n  const handleInputChange = (inputValue: string) =&gt; {\n    setEditValue(inputValue);\n    if (isValidNodeFieldVariableName(inputValue)) {\n      onChange?.(inputValue);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 复制变量名\n  const copyVariableName = () =&gt; {\n    if (value) {\n      navigator.clipboard.writeText(&#96;\\${${value}}&#96;);\n      setCopied(true);\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; setCopied(false), 2000);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 显示文本\n  const displayText = useMemo\n;\n;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 工作流会话统计钩子\n */\nexport const useWorkflowSessionStats = () =&gt; {\n  const { recordSessionStats, sessionId } = useWorkflowStats();\n  const [sessionStartTime] = useState(Date.now());\n  const [visitedNodes, setVisitedNodes] = useState&lt;string[]&gt;([]);\n  const [completedNodes, setCompletedNodes] = useState&lt;string[]&gt;([]);\n\n  // 记录节点访问\n  const recordNodeVisit = useCallback((nodeId: string) =&gt; {\n    setVisitedNodes(prev =&gt; [...new Set([...prev, nodeId])]);\n  }, []);\n\n  // 记录节点完成\n  const recordNodeCompletion = useCallback((nodeId: string) =&gt; {\n    setCompletedNodes(prev =&gt; [...new Set([...prev, nodeId])]);\n  }, []);\n\n  // 记录会话结束\n  const recordSessionEnd = useCallback(async (exitNodeId?: string, exitReason?: string) =&gt; {\n    const sessionDuration = (Date.now() - sessionStartTime) / 1000;\n    const skippedNodes = visitedNodes.filter(nodeId =&gt; !completedNodes.includes(nodeId));\n    \n    try {\n      await recordSessionStats({\n        session_duration: sessionDuration,\n        total_nodes_visited: visitedNodes.length,\n        completed_nodes: completedNodes.length,\n        skipped_nodes: skippedNodes.length,\n        node_visit_sequence: JSON.stringify(visitedNodes),\n        node_completion_status: JSON.stringify(completedNodes),\n        exit_node_id: exitNodeId,\n        exit_reason: exitReason,\n        exit_time: new Date().toISOString(),\n        workflow_path: JSON.stringify({\n          visited: visitedNodes,\n          completed: completedNodes,\n          skipped: skippedNodes\n        }),\n        path_efficiency_score: completedNodes.length / visitedNodes.length || 0\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('记录会话结束失败:', error);\n    }\n  }, [sessionStartTime, visitedNodes, completedNodes, recordSessionStats]);\n\n  return {\n    sessionId,\n    recordNodeVisit,\n    recordNodeCompletion,\n    recordSessionEnd\n  };\n};",

        },
        "contents": "export function useKnowledgePointSort(\n  knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoint[],\n  columnConfigs: ColumnConfig[]\n) {\n\n}\n\n// 知识点选择Hook\nexport function useKnowledgePointSelection(\n  selectionMode: 'none' | 'single' | 'multiple' = 'single'\n) {\n  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState&lt;Set&lt;string&gt;&gt;(new Set());\n\n  const selectPoint = useCallback((id: string) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedIds(prev =&gt; {\n      const newSet = new Set(prev);\n      \n      if (selectionMode === 'single') {\n        newSet.clear();\n        newSet.add(id);\n      } else if (selectionMode === 'multiple') {\n        if (newSet.has(id)) {\n          newSet.delete(id);\n        } else {\n          newSet.add(id);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      return newSet;\n    });\n  }, [selectionMode]);\n\n  const selectAll = useCallback((pointIds: string[]) =&gt; {\n    if (selectionMode === 'multiple') {\n      setSelectedIds(new Set(pointIds));\n    }\n  }, [selectionMode]);\n\n  const clearSelection = useCallback(() =&gt; {\n    setSelectedIds(new Set());\n  }, []);\n\n  const isSelected = useCallback((id: string) =&gt; {\n    return selectedIds.has(id);\n  }, [selectedIds]);\n\n  const getSelectedPoints = useCallback((allPoints: KnowledgePoint[]) =&gt; {\n    return allPoints.filter(point =&gt; selectedIds.has(point.id));\n  }, [selectedIds]);\n\n  return {\n    selectedIds: Array.from(selectedIds),\n    selectPoint,\n    selectAll,\n    clearSelection,\n    isSelected,\n    getSelectedPoints,\n    hasSelection: selectedIds.size &gt; 0,\n    selectionCount: selectedIds.size\n  };\n}\n\n// 工具函数：获取嵌套对象的值\nfunction getNestedValue(obj: any, path: string): any {\n  return\n}",
